## Referência: references/squad/data/design-system-modes.yaml

```yaml
id: design-system-modes
version: "1.0.0"
status: active
owner: design-ops
scope: skill-user-facing
origin: "Wave B.5 — modes absorbed from claw-design invoke_skill vocabulary"
external_reference: "external/claw-design-system-prompt-2026-04-18.txt lines 316-333"

# The 13 modes/presets that /design-system can invoke. Each is a named work
# pattern mirroring claw-design's invoke_skill vocabulary. Adds human-friendly
# command vocabulary on top of the raw deliverable kinds.
#
# User-facing invocation:
#   /design-system "cria um botão primary"                    (auto-detects mode)
#   /design-system --mode deck "apresentação Q4"              (explicit mode)
#   /design-system --mode make-tweakable existing-artifact.html
#
# Each mode resolves to a deliverable kind + extra invariants.

# =============================================================================
# MODES
# =============================================================================
modes:

  create-component:
    label: "Criar componente"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Interactive prototype (for components)"
    deliverable_kind: component
    consistency_model: reference-first
    default_variants: 1
    default_divergence_posture: "ask before exploring"
    typical_user_input_patterns:
      - "preciso de um {component_name}"
      - "cria um {component_name} pra {business}"
      - "faz um botão/input/card/modal/..."

  interactive-prototype:
    label: "Protótipo interativo"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Interactive prototype"
    deliverable_kind: html_prototype
    consistency_model: copy-first
    default_variants: 3
    default_divergence_posture: "explore divergent"
    wave_c_runtime_required: true
    typical_user_input_patterns:
      - "preciso de um protótipo de {flow}"
      - "prototipa o onboarding"
      - "mockup interativo de {feature}"

  make-deck:
    label: "Fazer deck"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Make a deck"
    deliverable_kind: deck
    consistency_model: copy-first
    default_variants: 3
    default_divergence_posture: "explore divergent"
    starter_component_required: deck_stage.js
    wave_c_runtime_required: true
    typical_user_input_patterns:
      - "deck pra {audience}"
      - "apresentação do Q{N}"
      - "slides sobre {topic}"

  make-tweakable:
    label: "Adicionar tweaks a um artefato existente"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Make tweakable"
    deliverable_kind: "inherits from source artifact"
    mode_nature: transformation  # not creation — takes existing, adds tweaks
    required_input: "path to existing artifact"
    applies_tweak_protocol: true
    wave_c_runtime_required: true
    typical_user_input_patterns:
      - "adiciona tweaks em {existing_artifact}"
      - "quero mudar live esse {artifact}"

  frontend-design:
    label: "Direção estética (greenfield)"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Frontend design"
    deliverable_kind: "varies — typically page or component"
    consistency_model: "N/A — no DS exists yet"
    invoked_when: "user has no existing brand or design system"
    default_variants: 3
    default_divergence_posture: "bold aesthetic direction"
    typical_user_input_patterns:
      - "não tenho DS ainda, vamos começar do zero"
      - "me dá direção estética pra {surface}"

  wireframe:
    label: "Wireframe (baixa fidelidade, exploração ampla)"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Wireframe"
    deliverable_kind: html_prototype
    consistency_model: "relaxed — structure over polish"
    default_variants: 5  # more variants when exploring
    default_fidelity: low
    typical_user_input_patterns:
      - "wireframe de {flow}"
      - "versão rascunho antes de desenhar bonito"

  export-pptx-editable:
    label: "Exportar deck como PPTX editável"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Export as PPTX (editable)"
    mode_nature: export  # takes existing deck, exports format
    deliverable_kind: pptx
    source_required: "deck (html)"
    consistency_model: runtime-export
    wave_c_runtime_required: true
    typical_user_input_patterns:
      - "exporta esse deck pra PowerPoint"
      - "salva como PPTX editável"

  export-pptx-screenshots:
    label: "Exportar deck como PPTX (screenshots, não editável)"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Export as PPTX (screenshots)"
    mode_nature: export
    deliverable_kind: pptx
    source_required: "deck (html)"
    consistency_model: runtime-export
    editability: frozen  # screenshots — no edit
    wave_c_runtime_required: true
    use_when: "native shapes export fails or visual fidelity is critical and editability not needed"

  create-design-system:
    label: "Criar design system do zero"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Create design system"
    deliverable_kind: "tokens + foundations + components catalog"
    mode_nature: greenfield_bootstrap
    produces:
      - tokens.yaml
      - foundations.yaml
      - component-contracts.yaml
      - motion-primitives.yaml
    consistency_model: "N/A — this is where the model gets defined"
    typical_user_input_patterns:
      - "cria um design system pra {business}"
      - "não temos DS, precisa criar"
      - "bootstrap do DS"
    related_workflow: squads/design-ops/workflows/wf-brandbook-workspace-extraction.yaml

  save-as-pdf:
    label: "Exportar como PDF"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Save as PDF"
    mode_nature: export
    deliverable_kind: pdf
    source_required: "html (any kind)"
    mechanism: "browser print dialog via open_for_print equivalent"
    requires: "print stylesheet in source"
    wave_c_runtime_required: true

  save-as-standalone-html:
    label: "Bundlar como HTML self-contained"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Save as standalone HTML"
    mode_nature: export
    deliverable_kind: html_prototype
    source_required: "html artifact with __bundler_thumbnail template"
    mechanism: "deterministic browser-side bundler (super_inline_html equivalent)"
    wave_c_runtime_required: true

  send-to-canva:
    label: "Exportar pra Canva editável"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Send to Canva"
    mode_nature: export
    deliverable_kind: "Canva design"
    source_required: "deck or html"
    status: "forward-declared; integration pending"
    wave_c_runtime_required: true

  handoff-to-claude-code:
    label: "Pacote de handoff pro @dev"
    claw_design_equivalent: "Handoff to Claude Code"
    mode_nature: handoff
    deliverable_kind: "developer handoff package"
    produces:
      - "spec files for each component"
      - "token export"
      - "integration notes"
    typical_downstream: "@dev or design-pages squad"

# =============================================================================
# MODE RESOLUTION HEURISTICS
# =============================================================================
resolution:

  by_natural_input:
    rules:
      - pattern: "protótipo|prototipo|mockup"
        mode: interactive-prototype
      - pattern: "deck|apresentação|slides|pitch|keynote"
        mode: make-deck
      - pattern: "wireframe|rascunho|baixa fidelidade"
        mode: wireframe
      - pattern: "exporta.*pptx|exporta.*powerpoint"
        mode: export-pptx-editable
      - pattern: "exporta.*pdf|salva.*pdf"
        mode: save-as-pdf
      - pattern: "bundle|self-contained|standalone"
        mode: save-as-standalone-html
      - pattern: "tweak|edição ao vivo|live edit"
        mode: make-tweakable
      - pattern: "cria.*design system|bootstrap.*ds|ds do zero"
        mode: create-design-system
      - pattern: "handoff|passa pro dev"
        mode: handoff-to-claude-code
      - pattern: "botão|button|input|card|modal|navbar|sidebar|form"
        mode: create-component
      - pattern: "landing|página|page|homepage"
        mode: create-component  # page is a component kind in our model
      - pattern: "sem ds|não tem design system|vamos do zero"
        mode: frontend-design
    fallback_mode: create-component

  by_explicit_flag:
    flag: "--mode"
    accepts: [create-component, interactive-prototype, make-deck, make-tweakable,
              frontend-design, wireframe, export-pptx-editable, export-pptx-screenshots,
              create-design-system, save-as-pdf, save-as-standalone-html,
              send-to-canva, handoff-to-claude-code]

# =============================================================================
# MODE-KIND MATRIX
# =============================================================================
mode_to_deliverable_kind:
  create-component: component
  interactive-prototype: html_prototype
  make-deck: deck
  make-tweakable: "inherits"
  frontend-design: "varies"
  wireframe: html_prototype
  export-pptx-editable: pptx
  export-pptx-screenshots: pptx
  create-design-system: "meta (creates tokens + foundations + catalog)"
  save-as-pdf: pdf
  save-as-standalone-html: html_prototype
  send-to-canva: "Canva design (external)"
  handoff-to-claude-code: "developer spec package"

# =============================================================================
# WAVE C GATING
# =============================================================================
wave_c_gated_modes:
  reason: "These modes require runtime capabilities pending ADR-018 approval"
  blocked_until_wave_c:
    - interactive-prototype (forward-declared)
    - make-deck (deck_stage runtime)
    - make-tweakable (tweak protocol runtime)
    - export-pptx-editable (gen_pptx runtime)
    - export-pptx-screenshots (gen_pptx runtime)
    - save-as-pdf (open_for_print runtime)
    - save-as-standalone-html (super_inline bundler)
    - send-to-canva (Canva integration)
  usable_now:
    - create-component
    - frontend-design (design output only)
    - wireframe (HTML-only, no advanced runtime)
    - create-design-system (via wf-brandbook-workspace-extraction)
    - handoff-to-claude-code

related:
  - .claude/skills/design-system/SKILL.md
  - squads/design-ops/data/deliverable-kinds-registry.yaml
  - squads/design-ops/data/claude-design-persona.yaml
  - squads/design-ops/data/starter-components-catalog.yaml
  - squads/design-ops/data/export-contracts-spec.yaml
  - docs/adrs/ADR-018-design-ops-artifact-creation-capability.md
```

## Referência: references/squad/data/design-token-best-practices.md

# Design Token Best Practices

**Source:** Brad's consolidation experience
**Purpose:** Token naming and organization standards

---

## Naming Conventions

### Semantic > Descriptive
✅ `color-primary` (semantic - describes purpose)
❌ `color-blue-500` (descriptive - describes appearance)

**Why:** Semantic names survive redesigns. If primary color changes from blue to purple, `color-primary` still works. `color-blue-500` becomes misleading.

### Use Kebab-Case
✅ `color-primary-dark`
❌ `colorPrimaryDark` or `color_primary_dark`

### Variant Suffixes
- `-light`: Lighter variant, backgrounds, disabled states
- `-dark`: Darker variant, hover states, active states
- `-hover`: Explicit hover state
- `-focus`: Explicit focus state

---

## Token Categories

**Required:**
- `color` - All color values
- `spacing` - Padding, margin, gaps
- `typography` - Fonts, sizes, weights, line-heights

**Recommended:**
- `radius` - Border radius values
- `shadow` - Box shadow presets
- `transition` - Animation timings
- `z-index` - Stacking order

---

## Token Organization

```yaml
color:
  # Primary
  primary: "#0066CC"
  primary-dark: "#0052A3"
  primary-light: "#E6F2FF"

  # Semantic
  error: "#DC2626"
  success: "#059669"
  warning: "#F59E0B"

  # Neutrals
  neutral-50: "#F9FAFB"
  neutral-900: "#111827"
```

---

## Token Values

**Colors:** Hex preferred (`#0066CC`), RGB/HSL acceptable
**Spacing:** Px units (`16px`), avoid rem in token definition
**Typography:** Px for sizes, unitless for line-height
**Timing:** Ms units (`200ms`)

---

## Multi-Format Exports

**Single source of truth:** `tokens.yaml`

**Export to:**
- `tokens.json` → JavaScript imports
- `tokens.css` → CSS custom properties
- `tokens.tailwind.js` → Tailwind theme
- `tokens.scss` → SCSS variables

**Keep formats in sync:** Regenerate all from tokens.yaml

---

## Token Usage

**Components:**
```css
.button {
  background: var(--color-primary);  /* Use token */
  padding: var(--space-md);          /* Use token */
  /* NOT: background: #0066CC; */    /* Hardcoded = bad */
}
```

**TypeScript:**
```typescript
import { tokens } from '@/tokens';
const primaryColor = tokens.color.primary;
```

---

## Brad says:
"Zero hardcoded values. Tokens or nothing."

## Referência: references/squad/data/ds-archetype.yaml

```yaml
# DS Archetype — Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui + TypeScript (framework-agnostic)
#
# Formalization of the pattern emergent across 3 reference implementations:
#   - apps/aiox-brandbook/       (full profile, framework=next — Storybook + DTCG + specialized primitives)
#   - apps/anthropic-ds/         (lean profile, framework=next — reference execution of DS migration workflow)
#   - apps/redpine-ds/           (lean profile, framework=next — minimal ~24 primitives)
#
# The archetype separates three tiers that together let the workflow produce
# non-identical DSs from a shared skeleton:
#   1. INVARIANT       — locked; every DS on this archetype has it (framework-agnostic)
#   2. PARAMETERIZED   — shaped by brief inputs (profile, framework, brand colors, typography)
#   3. EMERGENT        — discovered per-brand from the source static DS
#
# v2.0.0 (2026-04-19): promoted framework from locked Next.js to parameterized.
# Supported frameworks: next, vite (MVP). Architecture open for astro/remix/sveltekit.

archetype:
  id: ds-tailwind-shadcn
  version: 2.0.0
  description: >-
    Canonical Design System archetype. Framework-agnostic core: Tailwind CSS v4 +
    shadcn/ui (new-york) + Radix via `radix-ui` namespace + TypeScript strict.
    Target framework is a PARAMETER (next, vite, astro, remix, sveltekit) with
    per-framework shape defining config files, routing, image/link primitives,
    theme provider wiring, and build commands. Icons and animations are
    BRAND-DRIVEN (defaults: lucide-react + tw-animate-css, but per-business override
    is first-class — see `brand_driven` section). Produces a browseable DS surface
    (tokens, primitives, preview routes, kit routes) from any static DS source.
  owner: design-ops
  evidence:
    - app: apps/aiox-brandbook
      profile: full
      notes: "Storybook + DTCG tokens sync + 90+ primitives with stories"
    - app: apps/anthropic-ds
      profile: lean
      notes: "Reference execution of ds-static-to-dynamic-migration workflow (24 primitives + 4 composition + 3 kits)"
    - app: apps/redpine-ds
      profile: lean
      notes: "Minimal — 24 primitives, no Storybook, no DTCG"

# =============================================================================
# 1. INVARIANT — always present, non-negotiable across any DS built with this
# =============================================================================

invariant:

  stack:
    runtime: "Node.js >= 18"
    language: "TypeScript strict"
    styling: "Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/postcss)"
    component_kit: "shadcn/ui (style: new-york)"
    headless_primitives: "Radix UI (via `radix-ui` namespace package — NOT individual @radix-ui/* packages)"
    class_utils: ["class-variance-authority", "clsx", "tailwind-merge"]
    # NOT in invariant: framework (next|vite|astro|...), react version, router, image/link primitive, theme provider.
    # Those are in parameterized.framework — see shape per framework.
    # NOT in invariant: icons + animations (BRAND-DRIVEN — see brand_driven below).

  brand_driven:
    # Per-business choices. Defaults exist for fast bootstrap, but override is first-class.
    # Rationale: 39 reference DS analyzed (2026-04-27) — mature DS publish OWN icon systems,
    # icon library is brand expression not stack constraint. Same for animation library.
    # See: squads/design-ops/rules/stack-invariant-vs-framework-parameterized.md
    icons:
      default: "lucide-react"
      alternatives:
        - "@phosphor-icons/react"     # marketing / brand-rich / e-commerce (4 weights)
        - "@heroicons/react"          # tailwind-canonical / minimalist
        - "@tabler/icons-react"       # wide variety (5000+ icons)
        - "react-icons"               # multi-pack aggregator (logos / SaaS brands)
        - "@iconify/react"            # 200k+ icons via Iconify API
        - "internal-svg-component"    # brand-owned mark; small icon set
    animations:
      default: "tw-animate-css"
      alternatives:
        - "framer-motion"             # marketing / hero / gesture-driven
        - "motion"                    # vanilla; framework-agnostic
        - "@formkit/auto-animate"     # list/grid reorder
        - "@react-spring/web"         # physics-based, low-level
        - "css-keyframes"             # zero-dep micro-interactions

  config_files:
    required_all_frameworks:
      - package.json                  # deps + scripts (dev/build/start/lint/typecheck)
      - tsconfig.json                 # strict true; paths @/* → ./src/*
      - postcss.config.mjs            # @tailwindcss/postcss only (unified across frameworks)
      - components.json               # shadcn: new-york, rsc (framework-dependent), cssVariables true, baseColor neutral
      - .gitignore
    framework_specific:
      note: "See parameterized.framework.shape.{framework}.config_files — e.g., next.config.ts for next, vite.config.ts + index.html for vite."

  src_layout:
    required_all_frameworks:
      - src/components/ui/            # shadcn-style primitives (path identical across frameworks)
      - src/lib/utils.ts              # cn() helper (twMerge + clsx)
    framework_specific:
      note: "Entry file + globals.css path varies by framework. See parameterized.framework.shape.{framework}.src_layout."
    optional:
      - src/components/{logo,typography,nav}.tsx  # composition (brand-parameterized)
      - src/hooks/
      - src/styles/
      - src/design-system/            # token source-of-truth (full profile only)

  token_architecture:
    description: "Four-tier token resolution — generic shape, brand-specific values"
    tiers:
      - tier: 1
        name: raw_hsl
        description: "Space-separated HSL per channel. Enables dark-mode override via single-var flip."
        example: "--_bg-100: 48 33.3% 97.1%;"
        location: ":root in globals.css"
      - tier: 2
        name: semantic
        description: "Named design aliases consumed by kit code. Resolves to raw HSL."
        example: "--bg: hsl(var(--_bg-100));"
        location: ":root in globals.css"
      - tier: 3
        name: shadcn_slots
        description: "The surface names shadcn expects (background/foreground/primary/card/etc)."
        example: "--background: var(--bg); --primary: var(--ds-accent);"
        location: ":root in globals.css"
      - tier: 4
        name: theme_inline
        description: "@theme inline block — wires CSS vars into Tailwind utilities."
        example: "--color-background: var(--background); --text-h1: var(--fs-h1);"
        location: "@theme inline block in globals.css"

  dark_mode:
    mechanism: "`.dark` class on any ancestor flips raw HSL vars (framework-agnostic)"
    variant: "@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *));"
    persistence: "Framework-specific — next-themes works for next AND vite (package is framework-aware). Astro/Remix/SvelteKit have native theme primitives or can use next-themes."
    fouc_prevention: "Framework-specific. next: suppressHydrationWarning on <html>+<body>. vite: theme class applied synchronously in index.html <script> before React hydrates. See parameterized.framework.shape.{framework}.theme_provider."
    legacy_support: "[data-theme=\"dark\"] kept as fallback hook (all frameworks)"

  baseline_primitives:
    description: "24 shadcn-style primitives — always generated regardless of brand"
    list:
      - accordion
      - alert
      - avatar
      - badge
      - blockquote
      - breadcrumbs
      - button
      - card
      - checkbox
      - dialog
      - dropdown-menu
      - field
      - input
      - label
      - popover
      - select
      - separator
      - sheet
      - skeleton
      - switch
      - table
      - tabs
      - textarea
      - tooltip
    contract:
      per_primitive:
        - "cva for variants"
        - "data-slot attribute"
        - "asChild via radix-ui Slot (where applicable)"
        - "React.ComponentProps<typeof Primitive> typed props"
        - "cn() for className merge"
        - "\"use client\" only when Radix primitive requires client boundary"
        # GAP-DS-011 (Redpine session): maturity labels + a11y metadata mandatory
        - "MUST have `status: ready|beta|experimental|deprecated` in components.map.json"
        - "MUST have `a11y: {role, keyboard, aria, focus, notes}` in components.map.json"
        - "NEVER uses `ref` as a prop name in Client Components (reserved; breaks RSC)"
        - "Hover/active states use tokenized slots (--primary-hover/--primary-pressed), not opacity modifiers"

  quality_gates:
    required:
      - "npx tsc --noEmit exit 0"
      - "npm run build exit 0 (framework-agnostic — resolves to next build OR vite build per parameterized.framework)"
      - "Zero direct @radix-ui/* imports (all via `radix-ui` namespace)"
      - "Zero `any` types in src/"
      - "Zero bare <img> when framework provides image primitive (next: next/image mandatory; vite: <img> with width/height OR @unpic/react acceptable; astro: astro:assets)"
      - "Zero inline <svg> where the registered icon library covers it (allowlist: brand-specific SVGs only). Registered library is brand-driven — see brand_driven.icons in this file"
      - "Zero inline styles where scale token exists"
      - "All icon-only buttons have aria-label"
      - "All internal links via framework-idiomatic primitive (next: next/link; vite+react-router: react-router-dom <Link>; astro: <a> with prefetch OR ViewTransitions)"
      # GAP-DS-010 (2026-04-19, Redpine session): stack-discipline gates
      - "Zero prop named `ref` in Client Components (reserved — breaks RSC serialization in next; best-practice in all frameworks)"
      - "Zero `rounded-(xl|2xl)` outside brand radius ladder (runs check:drift script)"
      - "Zero `transition-all` — must be explicit property list + tokenized duration/ease"
      - "Zero `hover:bg-(primary|destructive|secondary)/N` opacity hacks — use `bg-*-hover` tokens"
      - "Zero `ring-[3px] ring-ring/50` alpha-hardcoded focus — use outline pattern (WCAG 2.2 AAA 3px+3px+transition:none)"
      - "Zero `shadow-(sm|md|lg|xs)` Tailwind defaults in components — use `shadow-[var(--shadow-N)]`"
      - "Semantic tokens NEVER reuse base-token names (semantic layer uses distinct prefix: --feedback-*, --action-*)"
      - "npm run check:drift exits 0 (token-component drift audit per Redpine playbook — baseline output)"
      - "components.map.json with `status` field committed (baseline output)"
      - "Framework-specific build gate — next: 34+ static routes; vite: chunks + index.html; astro: static/hybrid per config."

  mandatory_outputs:
    description: >-
      Tiered outputs by profile. Baseline applies to every DS regardless of framework/profile.
      Full-only applies when parameterized.profile = full (aiox-brandbook-style DSs with Storybook + agentic readiness).
      scaffold-ds.sh drops baseline always + full-only when --profile=full. CI enforces per-tier presence.

    baseline:
      description: "Required for every DS — any profile, any framework"
      files:
        - path: "scripts/check-token-drift.mjs"
          purpose: "5-rule grep-based drift audit (rounded-xl/transition-all/opacity-hover/ring-alpha/raw-shadow). Exits 1 on violation."
          source_template: "squads/design-ops/templates/check-token-drift.mjs.tmpl"
          framework_agnostic: true
        - path: "src/design-system/components.map.json"
          purpose: "Every component entry has `status: ready|beta|experimental|deprecated`. No status = G5 fail."
          framework_agnostic: true
        - injected_into_globals_css: "focus-indicators-global (:focus-visible outline 3px + transition:none + :is guards)"
          purpose: "WCAG 2.2 AAA focus policy applied globally, not per-component."
          source_template: "squads/design-ops/templates/focus-indicators-global.css.tmpl"
          framework_agnostic: true
      package_json_requirements:
        scripts: ["check:drift"]

    full_only:
      description: "Required when parameterized.profile = full. Unlocks Storybook + agentic/LSP integration."
      files:
        - path: "scripts/build-manifest.mjs"
          purpose: "Generates components.manifest.json (CEM-equivalent for React — MCP/LLM consumable)."
          source_template: "squads/design-ops/templates/build-manifest.mjs.tmpl"
          framework_agnostic: true
        - path: "src/design-system/exports/tokens.dtcg.json"
          purpose: "DTCG W3C-spec tokens ($value/$type/$description) for Figma/LSP/Style Dictionary interop."
          emitter: "build-tokens.mjs (extended to emit DTCG alongside CSS/TS)"
          framework_agnostic: true
        - path: "src/design-system/components.manifest.json"
          purpose: "Agentic manifest with status/a11y/exports/signatures/tokens per component (output of build-manifest.mjs)."
          framework_agnostic: true
      package_json_requirements:
        scripts: ["build:tokens", "build:manifest"]
        fields:
          - "designTokensLanguageServer: { prefix, tokensFiles: [./src/design-system/exports/tokens.dtcg.json] }"

  legacy_grandfather:
    description: >-
      Apps migrated before archetype v2.0.0 (anthropic-ds, redpine-ds) are grandfathered
      at the v1.0 baseline. They do not violate v2.0 mandatory_outputs — they are just
      pre-upgraded. Upgrade path: run `scaffold-ds.sh --upgrade-mandatory-outputs` to
      retrofit them (not authored yet; defer until demand).
    grandfathered_apps:
      - apps/anthropic-ds    # framework=next, profile=lean, pre-v2.0
      - apps/redpine-ds      # framework=next, profile=lean, pre-v2.0
      - apps/aiox-brandbook  # framework=next, profile=full, pre-v2.0 (partially compliant via tokens:sync script)

# =============================================================================
# 2. PARAMETERIZED — shaped by brief inputs; schema fixed, values vary
# =============================================================================

parameterized:

  framework:
    type: enum
    values: [next, vite, astro, remix, sveltekit]
    supported: [next, vite]  # MVP v2.0.0 — others architectural placeholders
    required: true
    default: next
    shape:
      next:
        description: "Next.js App Router (React 19 + RSC)"
        react_version: "19.x"
        framework_version: "16.x"
        config_files:
          - next.config.ts             # reactStrictMode; turbopack root
          - next-env.d.ts
          - eslint.config.mjs          # FlatCompat + next/core-web-vitals + next/typescript
        src_layout:
          root: src/app/
          entry: src/app/layout.tsx    # Root; wraps <html> + ThemeProvider
          home: src/app/page.tsx
          globals_css: src/app/globals.css
        router: "Next App Router (file-based, RSC-capable)"
        image_primitive: "next/image"
        link_primitive: "next/link"
        theme_provider: "next-themes + ThemeProvider in layout.tsx (attribute=\"class\")"
        client_directive: "\"use client\" required at top of files using Radix client primitives (Dialog, Popover, DropdownMenu, Tabs, etc)"
        build_command: "next build"
        dev_command: "next dev"
        components_json_rsc: true
      vite:
        description: "Vite + React (SPA, no RSC)"
        react_version: "19.x"
        framework_version: "5.x"
        config_files:
          - vite.config.ts             # @vitejs/plugin-react + @tailwindcss/vite
          - index.html                 # entry HTML (Vite convention)
          - eslint.config.mjs          # FlatCompat + eslint-plugin-react + eslint-plugin-react-hooks
        src_layout:
          root: src/
          entry: src/main.tsx          # Mounts <App /> to #root with ThemeProvider wrapper
          home: src/App.tsx            # Application root component
          globals_css: src/index.css
        router: "Optional react-router-dom (recommended for multi-route DSs) OR SPA (single view)"
        image_primitive: "<img> with width+height (native) OR @unpic/react (optional)"
        link_primitive: "react-router-dom <Link> if router present; else <a>"
        theme_provider: "next-themes (supports Vite — wrap <App /> in ThemeProvider) + synchronous class injection in index.html <script> for FOUC prevention"
        client_directive: "NOT USED — Vite is client-only. Primitives MUST be generated WITHOUT `\"use client\"` (shadcn CLI auto-detects Vite and omits it)."
        build_command: "vite build"
        dev_command: "vite dev"
        components_json_rsc: false
      astro:
        status: ARCHITECTURAL_PLACEHOLDER
        note: "Defer implementation until demand. Known-compatible: shadcn/ui + Tailwind v4 work. Issues to resolve: Astro Islands boundary, client:* directives, react/ integration pkg."
      remix:
        status: ARCHITECTURAL_PLACEHOLDER
        note: "Defer. Remix v2 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn tested; map to `app/routes/` instead of `src/app/`."
      sveltekit:
        status: ARCHITECTURAL_PLACEHOLDER
        note: "Defer. Requires non-React primitives — substantial rework. Likely a separate archetype (ds-tailwind-shadcn-svelte)."

  profile:
    type: enum
    values: [lean, full]
    required: true
    shapes:
      lean:
        description: "redpine-ds archetype — minimal, fast, no Storybook"
        deps_add: []
        scripts_add: {}
        visual_gate: "squads/design-ops/checklists/visual-gate-lean.yaml (manual)"
      full:
        description: "aiox-brandbook archetype — Storybook + DTCG + Chromatic + Playwright. Unlocks mandatory_outputs.full_only."
        deps_add:
          next:   [storybook, "@storybook/nextjs-vite", "@storybook/addon-a11y", "@storybook/addon-docs", "@storybook/addon-themes", "@chromatic-com/storybook", "@playwright/test"]
          vite:   [storybook, "@storybook/react-vite", "@storybook/addon-a11y", "@storybook/addon-docs", "@storybook/addon-themes", "@chromatic-com/storybook", "@playwright/test"]
        scripts_add: {storybook: "storybook dev -p 6007", "build-storybook": "storybook build", "test:visual": "playwright test"}
        visual_gate: "playwright automated regression"

  brand_colors:
    description: "Hue palette — every DS has these roles, values differ"
    shape:
      foundation:
        required: [bg, bg_subtle, bg_card, bg_inset]
        format: "HSL raw (space-separated)"
      text:
        required: [fg_1_primary, fg_2_secondary, fg_3_tertiary, fg_4_placeholder]
      border:
        required: [border, border_strong, border_focus]
      brand_accent:
        required: [accent, accent_hover, accent_soft, accent_ink]
        description: "The ONE signature brand color (terracotta for Anthropic, red for Redpine, lime for AIOX)"
      feedback:
        required: [success, info, warn, danger]
    examples:
      anthropic: "clay orange #d97757 + warm cream #faf9f5 + soft black #141413"
      redpine:   "red #ab2832 + bone + ink"
      aiox:      "neon lime #dcff3c + black + white"

  typography:
    description: "Font stacks — every DS has display/body/mono, families differ"
    shape:
      required_tiers: [display, body, mono]
      optional_tiers: [editorial_serif]
    fallback_policy: "If brand fonts unlicensed, declare fallback chain + flag substitution in README"
    examples:
      anthropic: "display=Styrene A (fallback Poppins); body=Styrene B (fallback Poppins); editorial=Tiempos (fallback Source Serif 4); mono=GT America Mono (fallback JetBrains Mono)"
      redpine:   "display=Magnetik (fallback Inter Tight); body=Inter Tight; mono=JetBrains Mono"
      aiox:      "display=Geist/Neue Haas Grotesk; body=Inter; mono=Geist Mono"

  casing:
    type: enum
    values: [Sentence, Title]
    description: "Brand guide determines heading casing — Sentence (Anthropic) vs Title (Redpine)"

  voice:
    tone: "brand_specific"
    schema:
      preferred_words: list
      forbidden_words: list
      punctuation_rules: "em-dashes, Oxford commas, exclamation marks, etc per brand"
      emoji_policy: "enum: forbidden | sparingly | allowed_contextual"

  kit_surfaces:
    description: "Product surfaces to rebuild — DISCOVERED from source (see emergent.discovery.surfaces), but classified here"
    taxonomy:
      - category: product
        examples: [chat, dashboard, settings, artifact-viewer]
        ds_seen_in: [anthropic-ds, aiox-brandbook]
      - category: marketing
        examples: [home, pricing, blog, article, changelog]
        ds_seen_in: [anthropic-ds, redpine-ds, aiox-brandbook]
      - category: docs
        examples: [api-reference, cookbook, release-notes]
        ds_seen_in: [anthropic-ds]
      - category: pitch-deck
        examples: [investor-pitch, sales-deck]
        ds_seen_in: [aiox-brandbook]
      - category: ops/safety
        examples: [incident-view, reports, integrations, risk-matrix]
        ds_seen_in: [redpine-ds]

# =============================================================================
# 3. EMERGENT — discovered from source DS; grows the archetype per-brand
# =============================================================================

emergent:

  discovery:
    description: "Phase 0 of the workflow scans the source static DS and emits brand-profile.yaml"

    brand_colors:
      scan_sources:
        - "legacy-static/**/*.css (CSS custom properties with color values)"
        - "legacy-static/preview/colors-*.html (declared color swatches)"
      extraction: "Parse HSL/hex values; cluster into foundation/accent/feedback; confidence score per mapping"
      output_schema: "brand_profile.colors (see parameterized.brand_colors.shape)"

    typography:
      scan_sources:
        - "legacy-static/**/*.css (@import, @font-face, font-family declarations)"
        - "legacy-static/preview/type-*.html"
      extraction: "Identify display/body/mono families; flag substitutions vs licensed originals"

    primitives:
      scan_sources:
        - "legacy-static/preview/components-*.html"
        - "legacy-static/ui_kits/**/*.{html,jsx,tsx}"
      baseline_match:
        method: "Structural parse — if source has button/badge/card/input/nav/field/alert markup, map to corresponding baseline shadcn primitive"
        always_generate: "All 24 invariant.baseline_primitives regardless of source coverage"
      specialized_detection:
        method: >-
          Scan for HTML patterns OUTSIDE the baseline shadcn vocabulary. Common specialized primitives
          seen across the 3 reference DSs — generate ONLY IF source evidence present.
        catalog:
          - name: animated-pill-nav
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["nav with pill-shaped items + animated indicator"]
          - name: article-card
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["blog/news list items with cover image + title + excerpt + metadata"]
          - name: author-card / team-card-horizontal
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["avatar + name + role + short bio"]
          - name: device-mockup-frame
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["iphone/laptop frame wrapping a screenshot"]
          - name: faq-item
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["question + collapsible answer, brand-styled vs plain accordion"]
          - name: grain-overlay / line-pattern
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["full-viewport texture overlay"]
          - name: grid-borders
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["decorative grid lines as layout scaffolding"]
          - name: icon-button
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["icon-only with circle/rounded container + specific size variants"]
          - name: mono-label / section-label / eyebrow
            evidence: all three
            signals: ["uppercase small letter-spaced label above heading"]
          - name: ontology-explorer / org-chart
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["tree/graph node with expand-collapse"]
          - name: post-benefit / pricing-benefit
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["check/cross + short feature description in pricing tables"]
          - name: segmented-control
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["2-3 linked buttons acting as toggle"]
          - name: stacked-avatars
            evidence: aiox-brandbook
            signals: ["overlapping avatars indicating group/team"]
          - name: composer
            evidence: anthropic-ds
            signals: ["textarea + tool pills + send button at bottom of chat"]
          - name: message (chat)
            evidence: anthropic-ds
            signals: ["user/assistant message bubble with role styling"]
          - name: project-card
            evidence: anthropic-ds
            signals: ["project tile with color swatch + name + description + metadata"]
          - name: hero (marketing)
            evidence: redpine-ds, anthropic-ds
            signals: ["large heading + subcopy + dual CTA + optional media"]
          - name: newsroom / article-list
            evidence: redpine-ds, anthropic-ds
            signals: ["grid of article cards, blog-index surface"]
          - name: cta-band
            evidence: redpine-ds, anthropic-ds
            signals: ["full-width accent-background section with headline + CTA"]
          - name: pillar-card
            evidence: anthropic-ds, redpine-ds
            signals: ["3-column feature blocks on homepage"]
      approval_gate:
        description: "Specialized primitives are PROPOSED to user; user approves subset before Organism 3 scaffolds them"
        default: "interactive — user confirms; yolo mode accepts all with evidence_score >= 0.7"

    surfaces:
      scan_sources: "legacy-static/ui_kits/*/"
      rule: "Each subdir of ui_kits/ becomes ONE kit route namespace. Don't hardcode anthropic-com/claude/docs."
      output_schema: |
        discovered_surfaces:
          - name: {dirname}
            category: {inferred from content patterns — product|marketing|docs|pitch-deck|ops}
            files: [list of .html/.jsx/.tsx]
            primitives_used: [list from primitives discovery]

    composition_components:
      scan_sources: "logos + typography demos + nav patterns"
      rule: "Logo variants per SVG in assets/; typography tiers per type-*.html; nav per components-nav.html or kit headers"

  growth:
    description: "The emergent catalog above GROWS as new DSs are migrated"
    policy:
      - "Every DS migration that discovers a genuinely new specialized primitive (evidence_score >= 0.9, used in ≥ 2 places) should PR-back to this archetype"
      - "Primitives that prove transferable across 2+ brands promote to a 'shared_emergent' tier"
      - "Shared emergent primitives eligible for promotion to invariant.baseline_primitives after used in 3+ DSs"

# =============================================================================
# Anti-patterns — what the archetype FORBIDS
# =============================================================================

forbids:
  - "Hardcoding brand-specific kit surface names in the workflow (e.g., 'claude', 'anthropic-com', 'docs' — let discovery drive)"
  - "Generating specialized primitives without source evidence (forced novelty)"
  - "Skipping baseline shadcn primitives because source doesn't show them (they're the shared language)"
  - "Direct @radix-ui/react-* imports (breaks namespace contract)"
  - "Tokens declared outside the 4-tier architecture (raw → semantic → shadcn_slots → @theme_inline)"
  - "Arbitrary Tailwind values where a scale token exists (leading-[1.55] when leading-body is wired)"
  - "Dark mode via JS class toggle without next-themes (no persistence, FOUC risk)"
  - "Inline SVG where the registered icon library has equivalent (breaks icon consistency; library is brand-driven per brand_driven.icons)"
  - "Guessing token values (hex codes, spacing scales, font stacks) from training-data memory when the source CSS exists — 'the tree is a menu, not the meal' (per Claude Design system prompt 2026-04-19). Discovery scripts MUST read and extract actual values; pixel fidelity to source > recollection"
  - "Mocking surfaces from scratch when existing legacy-static reference is present — LAST RESORT only, and only after explicit user approval"
  - "Aggressive gradient backgrounds on full surfaces (subtle radial accents inside illustrations are fine)"
  - "Decorative numbers/stats/icons with no function (data slop)"
  - "Generating a weak/approximated asset (icon, illustration, logo) when the real one is unavailable — 'in hi-fi design, a placeholder is better than a bad attempt at the real thing'. Missing assets get a clearly-marked placeholder + caveat in README.md, not an invention."
  - "Recreating a target UI from screenshots when the source code is accessible. Code > screenshots: read the actual tokens.ts / colors.css / globals.css and lift exact values. Screenshots are for ambiguity resolution only, never the primary source."
  # GAP-DS-012 (2026-04-19, Redpine session): stack-discipline anti-patterns
  - "Naming a semantic token the same as its base token (e.g., --rp-success base + --rp-success semantic → circular CSS var → silent unset. Semantic layer MUST use distinct prefix: --feedback-*, --action-*, --state-*)"
  - "Using `ref` as a prop name on any Client Component (React reserved — breaks Server→Client serialization with 'Refs cannot be used in Server Components' error). Rename to `code`, `identifier`, `slug`, etc."
  - "Overriding only custom semantic vars (--bg/--fg) in a palette system without ALSO overriding framework slots (--background/--foreground/--card). Shadcn utilities won't respond → white-on-white bugs on dark palettes."
  - "Per-component focus-visible utilities (`focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50`) instead of a SINGLE global rule in globals.css. WCAG 2.2 AAA requires: `:is(*, :hover):focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; transition: none; } :focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none; }`"
  - "Running structural renames (`git mv` of route groups, component dirs) while IDE buffers / watchers / other agents have those paths open. Symptoms: dirs keep re-appearing, parallel routes error, stale type caches. MUST audit concurrent writers + close buffers + kill watchers before structural moves. See rules/concurrent-writer-audit.md"

# =============================================================================
# Consumption contract — how the workflow uses this
# =============================================================================

consumed_by:
  workflow: squads/design-ops/workflows/ds-static-to-dynamic-migration.yaml
  contract:
    organism_0_discovery: "Reads `emergent.discovery` as scan protocol; writes brand-profile.yaml"
    organism_1_scaffold:  "Reads `invariant.config_files` + `invariant.src_layout`; writes configs + src skeleton"
    organism_2_tokens:    "Reads `invariant.token_architecture` + brand-profile.colors + brand-profile.typography; writes globals.css"
    organism_3_primitives: "Always generates `invariant.baseline_primitives` (24); conditionally generates `emergent.discovery.primitives.specialized_detection` entries approved at discovery"
    organism_4_routes:    "Derives surfaces from `brand-profile.surfaces` (NOT hardcoded claude/anthropic-com/docs)"
    organism_5_qa:        "Reads `invariant.quality_gates` as pass/fail criteria"
    organism_6_polish:    "Applies next-themes per `invariant` contract; icon library and animation library applied per `brand_driven` (defaults: lucide-react + tw-animate-css)"

references:
  sinkra_map: outputs/sinkra-squad/migracao-ds-estatico-para-dinamico-tokenizado/
  reference_execution: apps/anthropic-ds
  reference_lean: apps/redpine-ds
  reference_full: apps/aiox-brandbook
```

## Referência: references/squad/data/ds-discovery-paths.yaml

```yaml
id: ds-discovery-paths
version: "1.0.0"
status: active
owner: design-ops
scope: provider-contract
origin: squads/design-ops/rules/design-system-fidelity.md
external_reference: "agenmod/claw-design — extracted 2026-04-18"

# Canonical discovery matrix for locating design-system artifacts.
# Resolution order: workspace-first -> @sinkra/tokens-base -> brownfield fallbacks.
# Consumers MUST check paths in the declared order. The first match wins and
# subsequent paths are ignored for that artifact kind.

# =============================================================================
# CANONICAL PATHS (SOT — workspace-first)
# =============================================================================
canonical:

  tokens:
    priority: 1
    paths:
      - "workspace/businesses/{business}/L2-tactical/design/tokens.yaml"
    format: yaml
    required: true
    resolver: "squads/design-ops/scripts/resolve-workspace-contracts.cjs"

  foundations:
    priority: 1
    paths:
      - "workspace/businesses/{business}/L2-tactical/design/foundations.yaml"
    format: yaml
    required: true
    resolver: "squads/design-ops/scripts/resolve-workspace-contracts.cjs"

  component_contracts:
    priority: 1
    paths:
      - "workspace/businesses/{business}/L2-tactical/design/component-contracts.yaml"
    format: yaml
    required: true
    resolver: "squads/design-ops/scripts/resolve-workspace-contracts.cjs"

  motion_primitives:
    priority: 1
    paths:
      - "workspace/businesses/{business}/L2-tactical/design/motion-primitives.yaml"
    format: yaml
    required: false
    resolver: "squads/design-ops/scripts/resolve-workspace-contracts.cjs"

# =============================================================================
# FRAMEWORK DEFAULTS (SOT — hub-level)
# =============================================================================
framework_defaults:

  tokens_base:
    priority: 2
    paths:
      - "packages/tokens-base/tokens/"
    format: "dtcg-json"
    npm_package: "@sinkra/tokens-base"
    required: false
    fallback_when: "canonical.tokens missing for greenfield bootstrap only"

  ds_core_catalog:
    priority: 2
    paths:
      - "squads/design-ops/data/ds-core-catalog.yaml"
    format: yaml
    required: false
    purpose: "Registered @sinkra/ds-core components"

  ds_core_package:
    priority: 2
    paths:
      - "packages/ds-core/src/"
    format: "tsx + css"
    npm_package: "@sinkra/ds-core"
    required: false
    purpose: "Reference-first consumption target for bundler-backed artifacts"

# =============================================================================
# BROWNFIELD FALLBACK PATTERNS (when business workspace not yet materialized)
# =============================================================================
brownfield_fallbacks:
  enabled_when: "canonical paths do not resolve and workspace bootstrap is in progress"
  purpose: >-
    Allow design-ops to discover tokens in a brownfield business app before
    its workspace contract has been materialized. Used by
    wf-brandbook-workspace-extraction to seed the canonical workspace.
  action_on_match: >-
    Report the discovery as a proposal. Never consume directly for artifact
    generation — always route through workspace extraction first.

  tokens:
    priority: 3
    patterns:
      - "apps/{any}/src/tokens.{yaml,json,ts,js,css}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/design-system/tokens.{yaml,json,ts}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/theme/tokens.{yaml,json,ts}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/styles/tokens.css"
      - "apps/{any}/tailwind.config.{ts,js,mjs}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/app/globals.css"
      - "packages/{any}/tokens/"

  colors:
    priority: 3
    patterns:
      - "apps/{any}/src/colors.{ts,js}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/theme/colors.{ts,js}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/styles/colors.css"
      - "apps/{any}/src/styles/_colors.scss"

  theme:
    priority: 3
    patterns:
      - "apps/{any}/src/theme.{ts,js}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/theme/index.{ts,js}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/styles/theme.css"
      - "apps/{any}/src/styles/_variables.scss"

  typography:
    priority: 3
    patterns:
      - "apps/{any}/src/typography.{ts,js}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/theme/typography.{ts,js}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/styles/typography.css"
      - "apps/{any}/next.config.{ts,js,mjs}"   # next/font config

  components:
    priority: 3
    patterns:
      - "apps/{any}/src/components/"
      - "apps/{any}/src/design-system/"
      - "apps/{any}/src/ui/"
      - "apps/{any}/src/lib/components/"

  brand_assets:
    priority: 3
    patterns:
      - "apps/{any}/public/brand/"
      - "apps/{any}/public/assets/brand/"
      - "apps/{any}/src/assets/brand/"
      - "apps/{any}/src/brand/"

  motion:
    priority: 3
    patterns:
      - "apps/{any}/src/motion.{ts,js}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/theme/motion.{ts,js}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/animations/"

# =============================================================================
# EXTERNAL REFERENCE PATTERNS (read-only)
# =============================================================================
external_reference_patterns:
  purpose: >-
    Patterns for reading reference material from adjacent repos/projects when
    the source is not a canonical business workspace. These are READ-ONLY
    reference resolvers — never a consumption path.
  security_note: >-
    Only resolve to paths under the current workspace root. Never traverse
    outside the repo via .. or absolute paths pointing elsewhere.
  patterns:
    - "apps/aiox-design-starter/src/"      # reference starter runtime
    - "apps/{any}-brandbook/"              # reference brandbook surfaces
    - "outputs/design-ops/{business}/components/"   # prior art
    - "outputs/brand/{business}/"          # brand outputs

# =============================================================================
# INTEGRATION-SPECIFIC PATHS
# =============================================================================
integrations:

  storybook:
    paths:
      - "apps/{any}/.storybook/main.{ts,js,mjs}"
      - "apps/{any}/.storybook/preview.{ts,js}"
    authority_rule: "never_overrides_workspace_contracts"
    required: false

  figma_tokens_studio:
    paths:
      - "apps/{any}/tokens-studio.json"
      - "apps/{any}/tokens/$metadata.json"
    authority_rule: "never_overrides_workspace_contracts"
    required: false

  tailwind:
    paths:
      - "apps/{any}/tailwind.config.{ts,js,mjs}"
      - "apps/{any}/src/app/globals.css"    # Tailwind v4 @theme inline target
      - "packages/ds-core/tailwind.config.{ts,js}"
    authority_rule: "tokens_bind_via_theme_inline_directive_v4"
    version_expected: "tailwind@4.x"

# =============================================================================
# RESOLUTION PROTOCOL
# =============================================================================
resolution_protocol:
  steps:
    - step: 1
      action: "Resolve canonical paths (priority 1) for the target business"
      on_success: "Use canonical; skip remaining steps"
      on_miss: "Proceed to step 2"

    - step: 2
      action: "Check framework defaults (priority 2)"
      on_success: "Use framework default AS FALLBACK only; log fallback event"
      on_miss: "Proceed to step 3"

    - step: 3
      action: "Scan brownfield fallback patterns (priority 3)"
      on_success: >-
        Report discoveries as proposals for workspace extraction.
        DO NOT consume directly.
      on_miss: "Proceed to step 4"

    - step: 4
      action: "HALT and request workspace contract materialization"
      blocking: true
      rationale: >-
        Per design-system-fidelity.md R4 (Context-First Mandate),
        artifact generation without a DS context is prohibited.

# =============================================================================
# VALIDATION
# =============================================================================
validation:
  required_for_artifact_generation: true
  gate: design-chief
  blocking: true
  validators:
    - "squads/design-ops/scripts/resolve-workspace-contracts.cjs"
    - "squads/design-ops/scripts/validate-workspace-contracts.cjs"
  error_on_step_4: "DS_CONTEXT_MISSING"

# =============================================================================
# KNOWN LEGACY PATHS (to be migrated)
# =============================================================================
legacy_patterns_to_migrate:
  - legacy: "workspace/businesses/{business}/design/tokens.yaml"
    canonical: "workspace/businesses/{business}/L2-tactical/design/tokens.yaml"
    rule: ".claude/rules/workspace-dialect.md"
    migration_epic: "EPIC-120"
  - legacy: "workspace/businesses/{business}/brand/tokens.yaml"
    canonical: "workspace/businesses/{business}/L2-tactical/design/tokens.yaml"
    rule: ".claude/rules/workspace-dialect.md"

related:
  - squads/design-ops/rules/design-system-fidelity.md
  - squads/design-ops/rules/ds-consistency-policy.md
  - squads/design-ops/rules/context-gathering-protocol.md
  - squads/design-ops/data/ds-core-catalog.yaml
  - squads/design-ops/data/deliverable-kinds-registry.yaml
  - squads/design-ops/scripts/resolve-workspace-contracts.cjs
  - squads/design-ops/scripts/validate-workspace-contracts.cjs
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/ds-page-types-registry.yaml

```yaml
version: "2.0.0"
created: "2026-03-20"
language: "en"
purpose: "Machine-readable registry of design-system page types. It tells AI which pages to create, which sections each page must contain, and which shadcn/ui primitives plus Tailwind patterns should be used."

stack_contract:
  styling: "Tailwind CSS v4"
  primitives: "shadcn/ui"
  charts: "Recharts through the local shadcn chart wrapper"
  rule: "Use shadcn/ui primitive names and Tailwind pattern names only. Do not reference starter-specific component aliases in this registry."

generation_rules:
  - "Describe what each page must contain, not one fixed final layout."
  - "A page may vary in tone, density, color strategy, and composition as long as the required sections and contracts are preserved."
  - "When a page needs a richer block than raw shadcn primitives, use a composed block from composed_blocks."
  - "If a page is data-heavy, prefer tabs, table, chart, scroll-area, and sticky sidebars before inventing custom widgets."
  - "If a page is visual, prefer grid, gallery, frame, and editorial patterns before adding new component abstractions."

tiers:
  0: "Core foundations"
  1: "Core component documentation"
  2: "Advanced system patterns"
  3: "Showcase and expression"

variation_axes:
  tone:
    - "minimal"
    - "premium"
    - "bold"
    - "cinematic"
    - "editorial"
    - "developer-focused"
    - "corporate"
    - "playful"
  density:
    - "compact"
    - "balanced"
    - "generous"
  color_mode:
    - "light"
    - "dark"
    - "adaptive"
  chrome_style:
    - "quiet"
    - "productized"
    - "magazine"
    - "presentation"
  demo_depth:
    - "minimal"
    - "standard"
    - "deep"

available_primitives:
  shadcn_ui:
    - "accordion"
    - "avatar"
    - "badge"
    - "breadcrumb"
    - "button"
    - "card"
    - "chart"
    - "checkbox"
    - "collapsible"
    - "context-menu"
    - "dialog"
    - "dropdown-menu"
    - "hover-card"
    - "input"
    - "label"
    - "popover"
    - "progress"
    - "radio-group"
    - "scroll-area"
    - "select"
    - "separator"
    - "sheet"
    - "skeleton"
    - "slider"
    - "switch"
    - "table"
    - "tabs"
    - "textarea"
    - "toggle"
    - "toggle-group"
    - "tooltip"
  tailwind_patterns:
    - "page-shell"
    - "section-stack"
    - "content-width-sm"
    - "content-width-md"
    - "content-width-lg"
    - "responsive-grid-2"
    - "responsive-grid-3"
    - "responsive-grid-4"
    - "token-swatch-grid"
    - "comparison-grid"
    - "stats-strip"
    - "sticky-aside"
    - "editorial-columns"
    - "demo-stage"
    - "gallery-grid"
    - "masonry-grid"
    - "toolbar-row"
    - "step-rail"
    - "side-by-side"
    - "bento-grid"
    - "marquee-strip"
    - "tabbed-demo-surface"
    - "scroll-snap-rail"

composed_blocks:
  page_hero:
    purpose: "Standard page opener for a DS route."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["badge", "separator"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack", "content-width-md"]
    must_render: ["eyebrow", "page title", "one-paragraph summary"]
  token_swatch:
    purpose: "Reusable token display card for color, spacing, radius, or shadow."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tooltip"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["token-swatch-grid"]
    must_render: ["token name", "token value", "semantic role", "live preview"]
  specimen_panel:
    purpose: "Typography or icon specimen panel."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "separator"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack"]
    must_render: ["preview", "metadata", "usage note"]
  demo_card:
    purpose: "Interactive component demo with code or usage notes."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "separator", "button"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["demo-stage", "tabbed-demo-surface"]
    must_render: ["live demo", "variant label", "usage note"]
  state_matrix:
    purpose: "Show default, hover, focus, disabled, loading, and error states."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tabs", "tooltip"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid"]
    must_render: ["state label", "preview", "state-specific note"]
  metric_card:
    purpose: "Compact status or coverage summary."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "progress"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["stats-strip"]
    must_render: ["metric label", "metric value", "supporting caption"]
  step_block:
    purpose: "Ordered process or rule sequence."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["badge", "card", "separator"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["step-rail"]
    must_render: ["step number", "step title", "step description"]
  data_demo:
    purpose: "Table or chart showcase with filters."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "select", "button", "chart", "table"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["toolbar-row", "demo-stage"]
    must_render: ["control row", "live data surface", "interpretation note"]
  slide_canvas:
    purpose: "Presentation slide preview or narrative deck section."
    built_from:
      shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "badge"]
      tailwind_patterns: ["gallery-grid", "side-by-side"]
    must_render: ["slide preview", "narrative role", "format note"]

selection_presets:
  mvp:
    description: "Fast starter for a small but credible design system."
    include: ["foundations", "typography", "color-tokens", "spacing-layout", "surfaces", "semantic-tokens", "buttons", "forms"]
  standard:
    description: "Balanced system for most product brands."
    include: ["foundations", "typography", "color-tokens", "spacing-layout", "surfaces", "semantic-tokens", "components-overview", "buttons", "forms", "feedback", "states", "cards", "tables", "navigation", "motion"]
  premium:
    description: "Broader system with data display and expressive pages."
    include: ["foundations", "typography", "color-tokens", "spacing-layout", "surfaces", "semantic-tokens", "token-export", "components-overview", "buttons", "forms", "feedback", "states", "cards", "tables", "lists", "charts", "navigation", "motion", "patterns", "effects", "templates"]
  full:
    description: "Full brandbook-grade system with utility, narrative, and showcase pages."
    include: ["foundations", "typography", "color-tokens", "spacing-layout", "surfaces", "semantic-tokens", "token-export", "components-overview", "buttons", "forms", "feedback", "states", "cards", "tables", "lists", "charts", "navigation", "motion", "patterns", "effects", "icons", "logo", "templates", "lp-sections", "editorial", "moodboard", "seo", "slides"]

page_types:
  foundations:
    tier: 0
    label: "Foundations"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/foundations"]
    purpose: "Entry page that orients the system and links to every foundation layer."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in any multi-page design system."
    required_sections:
      - id: "page-hero"
        composed_blocks: ["page_hero"]
        shadcn_ui: ["badge", "separator"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack", "content-width-md"]
        must_render: ["eyebrow", "title", "summary", "system scope"]
      - id: "foundation-grid"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "button"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-3"]
        must_render: ["foundation cards", "short descriptions", "route links", "coverage cues"]
      - id: "system-status"
        composed_blocks: ["metric_card"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "progress", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["stats-strip"]
        must_render: ["token count", "component count", "coverage summary"]

  typography:
    tier: 0
    label: "Typography"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/typography"]
    purpose: "Document font families, type scale, hierarchy, and reading behavior."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in any design system."
    required_sections:
      - id: "font-families"
        composed_blocks: ["specimen_panel"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "separator"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-2"]
        must_render: ["family specimen", "font family name", "fallback stack", "recommended use"]
      - id: "type-scale"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "table", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack", "content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["token name", "size", "line-height", "letter-spacing", "live preview"]
      - id: "heading-hierarchy"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "separator", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack"]
        must_render: ["H1-H6 preview", "usage note", "hierarchy rationale"]
      - id: "body-and-code"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side"]
        must_render: ["body copy sample", "small/caption sample", "code sample", "line length guidance"]

  color-tokens:
    tier: 0
    label: "Color Tokens"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/color-tokens"]
    purpose: "Document palette, semantic mapping, surfaces, and contrast behavior."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in any design system."
    required_sections:
      - id: "accent-and-brand-palette"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["token-swatch-grid"]
        must_render: ["brand colors", "token values", "semantic labels", "light/dark preview"]
      - id: "neutral-scale"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "tooltip", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["token-swatch-grid"]
        must_render: ["neutral steps", "foreground/background preview", "value label"]
      - id: "semantic-colors"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-4"]
        must_render: ["success", "warning", "error", "info", "usage note"]
      - id: "contrast-check"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "badge", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["foreground/background pairs", "contrast ratio", "pass/fail status"]

  spacing-layout:
    tier: 0
    label: "Spacing & Layout"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/spacing-layout", "/brandbook/spacing", "/brandbook/spacing-scale", "/brandbook/layering"]
    purpose: "Document spacing scales, breakpoint logic, layout rails, and layering rules."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in any design system."
    required_sections:
      - id: "spacing-scale"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "separator"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack"]
        must_render: ["token name", "pixel/rem value", "visual bar", "usage note"]
      - id: "layout-rails"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side", "demo-stage"]
        must_render: ["container widths", "column behavior", "gutter strategy", "layout examples"]
      - id: "breakpoints-and-layering"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "badge", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["breakpoints", "intended device targets", "z-index or layering map"]

  surfaces:
    tier: 0
    label: "Surfaces & Borders"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/surfaces"]
    purpose: "Show elevation, borders, corner radius, and surface hierarchy."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in any design system."
    required_sections:
      - id: "elevation-scale"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-3"]
        must_render: ["surface preview", "elevation token", "shadow value", "recommended usage"]
      - id: "border-and-radius"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-4"]
        must_render: ["border strength", "radius scale", "preview tile"]
      - id: "surface-hierarchy"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "separator", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side"]
        must_render: ["background", "panel", "card", "overlay", "hierarchy guidance"]

  semantic-tokens:
    tier: 0
    label: "Semantic Tokens"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/semantic-tokens"]
    purpose: "Explain semantic token roles independently from raw visual values."
    inclusion_rule: "Include whenever semantic aliasing exists."
    required_sections:
      - id: "semantic-map"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "badge", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["semantic token", "raw token source", "intended context", "theme mode behavior"]
      - id: "surface-and-content-pairs"
        composed_blocks: ["token_swatch"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid"]
        must_render: ["surface token", "text token", "pair preview", "accessibility note"]

  token-export:
    tier: 2
    label: "Token Export"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/token-export"]
    purpose: "Expose exportable token structures for engineering handoff."
    inclusion_rule: "Include when the design system has cross-tool or runtime handoff needs."
    required_sections:
      - id: "export-targets"
        shadcn_ui: ["tabs", "card", "badge", "button"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["tabbed-demo-surface"]
        must_render: ["target formats", "copy/export actions", "format explanation"]
      - id: "token-contract"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "scroll-area", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["token keys", "semantic grouping", "delivery notes"]

  components-overview:
    tier: 1
    label: "Components"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/components"]
    purpose: "Overview page for the component catalog and grouping logic."
    inclusion_rule: "Include whenever the system documents more than one component family."
    required_sections:
      - id: "catalog-hero"
        composed_blocks: ["page_hero"]
        shadcn_ui: ["badge", "separator"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack", "content-width-md"]
        must_render: ["title", "catalog scope", "component family count"]
      - id: "component-family-grid"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "button"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-3"]
        must_render: ["family card", "family description", "component count", "route or jump link"]
      - id: "coverage-summary"
        composed_blocks: ["metric_card"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "progress", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["stats-strip"]
        must_render: ["coverage by family", "maturity status", "missing areas"]

  buttons:
    tier: 1
    label: "Buttons"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/buttons"]
    purpose: "Document button variants, sizes, icon rules, grouping, and CTA hierarchy."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include when the system is interactive."
    required_sections:
      - id: "variant-matrix"
        composed_blocks: ["demo_card", "state_matrix"]
        shadcn_ui: ["button", "card", "tabs", "badge", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid", "demo-stage"]
        must_render: ["all variants", "all sizes", "primary/secondary intent", "icon usage"]
      - id: "state-coverage"
        composed_blocks: ["state_matrix"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tabs", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid"]
        must_render: ["default", "hover", "focus", "disabled", "loading"]
      - id: "button-groups-and-cta-rules"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "separator", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side"]
        must_render: ["group examples", "CTA priority rules", "spacing rules"]

  forms:
    tier: 1
    label: "Forms"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/forms"]
    purpose: "Document data entry primitives and composed form patterns."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include in product-oriented systems."
    required_sections:
      - id: "field-primitives"
        shadcn_ui: ["input", "textarea", "select", "checkbox", "radio-group", "switch", "label", "card", "tabs"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-2", "demo-stage"]
        must_render: ["field demos", "labels", "helper text", "validation affordances"]
      - id: "form-layout-patterns"
        composed_blocks: ["step_block"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "separator", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side", "section-stack"]
        must_render: ["single-column form", "two-column form", "dense settings layout"]
      - id: "validation-and-submission"
        shadcn_ui: ["button", "badge", "progress", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack"]
        must_render: ["error pattern", "success pattern", "pending/loading pattern", "submit hierarchy"]

  feedback:
    tier: 1
    label: "Feedback"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/feedback", "/brandbook/loading"]
    purpose: "Document user feedback and system response patterns."
    inclusion_rule: "Include whenever the product exposes async or transactional flows."
    required_sections:
      - id: "inline-feedback"
        shadcn_ui: ["badge", "card", "progress", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-3"]
        must_render: ["success", "warning", "error", "informational feedback"]
      - id: "loading-and-empty"
        shadcn_ui: ["skeleton", "progress", "card", "button"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid"]
        must_render: ["skeleton state", "progress state", "empty state", "retry state"]
      - id: "modal-and-blocking-feedback"
        shadcn_ui: ["dialog", "sheet", "button", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side"]
        must_render: ["modal feedback example", "sheet feedback example", "escape hatch rule"]

  states:
    tier: 1
    label: "States"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/states"]
    purpose: "Make state coverage explicit across the system."
    inclusion_rule: "Include whenever interaction states are not already embedded in every component page."
    required_sections:
      - id: "global-state-legend"
        shadcn_ui: ["badge", "card", "separator"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["stats-strip"]
        must_render: ["state taxonomy", "meaning", "visual cue"]
      - id: "component-state-matrix"
        composed_blocks: ["state_matrix"]
        shadcn_ui: ["tabs", "card", "badge", "tooltip"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid"]
        must_render: ["default", "hover", "focus", "active", "disabled", "selected", "loading", "error"]

  cards:
    tier: 1
    label: "Cards"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/cards"]
    purpose: "Show card families, density, content hierarchy, and media behavior."
    inclusion_rule: "Include whenever the product uses repeatable content containers."
    required_sections:
      - id: "card-family-gallery"
        composed_blocks: ["demo_card"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tabs", "button", "avatar"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["gallery-grid", "demo-stage"]
        must_render: ["basic card", "feature card", "article card", "profile or team card"]
      - id: "content-hierarchy-rules"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "separator", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side"]
        must_render: ["header/body/footer rules", "media placement rules", "density guidance"]
      - id: "state-and-layout-variants"
        composed_blocks: ["state_matrix"]
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "tabs", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["comparison-grid"]
        must_render: ["interactive card", "static card", "selected card", "disabled card"]

  tables:
    tier: 1
    label: "Tables"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/tables"]
    purpose: "Document structured data tables, density, and row actions."
    inclusion_rule: "Include whenever the product exposes tabular data."
    required_sections:
      - id: "table-foundation"
        composed_blocks: ["data_demo"]
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "card", "badge", "select", "button", "scroll-area"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["demo-stage", "toolbar-row"]
        must_render: ["column header row", "body rows", "sortable controls", "dense vs relaxed modes"]
      - id: "row-actions-and-status"
        shadcn_ui: ["dropdown-menu", "badge", "button", "tooltip", "table"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["row action menu", "selection state", "status badge", "empty rows behavior"]

  lists:
    tier: 1
    label: "Lists"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/lists"]
    purpose: "Document list items, metadata density, and sequence patterns."
    inclusion_rule: "Include when the system supports feeds, documents, or repeated content entries."
    required_sections:
      - id: "list-item-families"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "avatar", "separator", "button"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["section-stack", "content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["simple list item", "media list item", "meta-rich list item", "actionable list item"]
      - id: "selection-and-grouping"
        shadcn_ui: ["checkbox", "badge", "tabs", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["side-by-side"]
        must_render: ["single-select pattern", "multi-select pattern", "group label pattern"]

  charts:
    tier: 2
    label: "Charts"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/charts"]
    purpose: "Document data visualization primitives, controls, and narrative framing."
    inclusion_rule: "Include when the product presents trends, breakdowns, or performance data."
    required_sections:
      - id: "chart-gallery"
        composed_blocks: ["data_demo"]
        shadcn_ui: ["chart", "card", "tabs", "select", "button", "tooltip", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["responsive-grid-2", "demo-stage"]
        must_render: ["line", "bar", "area", "pie or radial", "legend", "tooltip behavior"]
      - id: "chart-usage-rules"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "badge", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["when to use each chart", "color semantics", "annotation rules"]

  navigation:
    tier: 1
    label: "Navigation"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/navigation"]
    purpose: "Document primary, secondary, local, and mobile navigation."
    inclusion_rule: "Always include when the product has more than one major route."
    required_sections:
      - id: "global-nav"
        shadcn_ui: ["button", "dropdown-menu", "sheet", "breadcrumb", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["toolbar-row", "side-by-side"]
        must_render: ["desktop nav", "mobile nav", "active state", "CTA slot"]
      - id: "local-and-contextual-nav"
        shadcn_ui: ["tabs", "toggle-group", "popover", "tooltip", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["sticky-aside", "content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["local tabs", "filter controls", "breadcrumb usage", "context actions"]

  motion:
    tier: 2
    label: "Motion"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/motion"]
    purpose: "Document easing, duration, and interaction choreography."
    inclusion_rule: "Include when motion is part of the system's brand or product UX."
    required_sections:
      - id: "timing-tokens"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "table"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["duration tokens", "easing tokens", "trigger contexts"]
      - id: "motion-demos"
        shadcn_ui: ["tabs", "card", "button", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["demo-stage", "responsive-grid-2"]
        must_render: ["enter motion", "exit motion", "hover motion", "page transition rule"]

  patterns:
    tier: 2
    label: "Patterns"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/patterns"]
    purpose: "Document reusable visual pattern language outside core components."
    inclusion_rule: "Include when the system has a visual identity beyond neutral product UI."
    required_sections:
      - id: "pattern-library"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "tabs"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["gallery-grid"]
        must_render: ["grid patterns", "line patterns", "texture motifs", "framing motifs"]
      - id: "application-rules"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "card", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["where patterns can appear", "where they must not appear", "density guidance"]

  effects:
    tier: 2
    label: "Effects"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/effects"]
    purpose: "Document blur, overlays, grain, glow, and other surface effects."
    inclusion_rule: "Include when the visual language relies on atmospheric treatment."
    required_sections:
      - id: "effect-gallery"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "badge", "slider", "tabs"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["gallery-grid", "demo-stage"]
        must_render: ["effect preview", "intensity comparison", "layering note"]
      - id: "performance-and-legibility"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "badge", "card"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["performance guidance", "accessibility note", "fallback rules"]

  icons:
    tier: 2
    label: "Icons"
    starter_routes: ["/brandbook/icons"]
    purpose: "Document icon families, stroke logic, sizing, and usage."
    inclusion_rule: "Include when icons are part of the product UI or brand language."
    required_sections:
      - id: "icon-grid"
        shadcn_ui: ["card", "tooltip", "badge", "tabs", "button"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["gallery-grid", "toolbar-row"]
        must_render: ["icon gallery", "size options", "stroke or weight logic", "category filters"]
      - id: "icon-usage-rules"
        shadcn_ui: ["table", "card", "badge"]
        tailwind_patterns: ["content-width-lg"]
        must_render: ["with label", "standalone", "decorative vs semantic", "contrast rules"]
```
