## Referência: references/squad/templates/design-generation-prompt-tmpl.md

# Design Generation Prompt Template

> Template padrao para formatar prompts de geracao de UI/componentes.
> Todas as tasks de geracao devem popular este template antes de enviar ao agente executor.
>
> Baseado em: google-labs-code/stitch-skills (enhance-prompt + text-to-design)
> Epic: epic-stitch-design-intelligence (Story 2)
> Version: 1.0.0

## Instrucoes de Uso

1. O agente que recebe um pedido de geracao DEVE popular este template antes de executar
2. Carregar o DS ativo via `*show-context` ou config para preencher o bloco DESIGN SYSTEM
3. Consultar `data/design-mappings.yaml` para traduzir termos vagos
4. O template preenchido e o prompt final enviado ao modelo

## Template

```markdown
{{vibe_line}}

**DESIGN SYSTEM (REQUIRED):**
- Platform: {{platform}}
- Theme: {{theme_description}}
- Background: {{bg_name}} ({{bg_hex}}) {{bg_role}}
- Surface: {{surface_name}} ({{surface_hex}}) for {{surface_role}}
- Primary Accent: {{accent_name}} ({{accent_hex}}) for {{accent_role}}
- Text Primary: {{text_primary_name}} ({{text_primary_hex}})
- Text Secondary: {{text_secondary_name}} ({{text_secondary_hex}})
- Typography: {{font_display}} for headlines, {{font_body}} for body, {{font_mono}} for labels/metadata
- Roundness: {{roundness_description}}
- Elevation: {{depth_description}}
- Borders: {{border_description}}

**PAGE STRUCTURE:**
1. **{{section_1_name}}:** {{section_1_description}}
2. **{{section_2_name}}:** {{section_2_description}}
3. **{{section_3_name}}:** {{section_3_description}}
4. **{{section_4_name}}:** {{section_4_description}}
{{additional_sections}}

**COMPONENT CONSTRAINTS (if applicable):**
{{component_constraints}}

**STATES REQUIRED:**
- Default, Hover, Focus-visible, Disabled
{{additional_states}}
```

## Placeholder Reference

| Placeholder | Tipo | Origem | Obrigatorio |
|-------------|------|--------|-------------|
| `vibe_line` | string | 1 frase descrevendo mood/purpose. Consultar `design-mappings.yaml > atmosphere` | Sim |
| `platform` | enum | "Web, Desktop-first" ou "Web, Mobile-first" ou "Mobile native" | Sim |
| `theme_description` | string | Adjetivos de atmosfera. Consultar `design-mappings.yaml > atmosphere` | Sim |
| `bg_name` | string | Nome descritivo da cor de fundo. Ex: "Void Dark" | Sim |
| `bg_hex` | string | Hex da cor de fundo. Ex: "#131313" | Sim |
| `bg_role` | string | Funcao. Ex: "primary canvas" | Nao |
| `surface_name` | string | Nome descritivo da cor de surface. Ex: "Charcoal Surface" | Sim |
| `surface_hex` | string | Hex. Ex: "#1b1b1b" | Sim |
| `surface_role` | string | Ex: "card backgrounds" | Sim |
| `accent_name` | string | Nome descritivo da cor accent. Ex: "Electric Blue" ou "Emerald" | Sim |
| `accent_hex` | string | Hex da cor accent da brand. Ex: "#3B82F6" ou "#22C55E" | Sim |
| `accent_role` | string | Ex: "primary actions and active states" | Sim |
| `text_primary_name` | string | Ex: "Warm White" | Sim |
| `text_primary_hex` | string | Ex: "#ffffff" | Sim |
| `text_secondary_name` | string | Ex: "Muted Silver" | Sim |
| `text_secondary_hex` | string | Ex: "#c8c6c5" ou "rgba(244,244,244,0.52)" | Sim |
| `font_display` | string | Ex: "Tasa Orbiter 800" ou "Space Grotesk 700" | Sim |
| `font_body` | string | Ex: "Geist 400" ou "Manrope 400" | Sim |
| `font_mono` | string | Ex: "Geist Mono 500" ou "IBM Plex Mono 500" | Sim |
| `roundness_description` | string | Consultar `design-mappings.yaml > geometry > border_radius`. Ex: "Sharp, squared-off edges (0px globally)" | Sim |
| `depth_description` | string | Consultar `design-mappings.yaml > depth`. Ex: "Tonal layering only, no shadows" | Sim |
| `border_description` | string | Ex: "Ghost borders at 15% opacity maximum" | Nao |
| `section_N_name` | string | Ex: "Header", "Hero Section", "Content Area", "Footer" | Sim (min 3) |
| `section_N_description` | string | Descricao do conteudo da secao | Sim |
| `additional_sections` | string | Secoes extras alem das 4 padrao | Nao |
| `component_constraints` | string | Regras especificas de componentes. Ex: "Cards must be open-ended (no border on all 4 sides)" | Nao |
| `additional_states` | string | Estados extras. Ex: "Active, Selected, Error, Loading" | Nao |

## Exemplos Preenchidos

### Exemplo 1: Landing Page Brutalista

```markdown
A precision-engineered landing page that feels like a high-end command center, with asymmetric layout, data-dense hero section, and neon accent against void-dark surfaces.

**DESIGN SYSTEM (REQUIRED):**
- Platform: Web, Desktop-first
- Theme: Raw, high-density, brutalist, command-center precision
- Background: Void Dark (#131313) primary canvas
- Surface: Charcoal Surface (#1b1b1b) for section backgrounds
- Primary Accent: {accent_name} ({accent_hex}) for primary actions and critical status
- Text Primary: Warm White (#ffffff)
- Text Secondary: Muted Silver (#c8c6c5)
- Typography: Tasa Orbiter 800 for headlines, Geist 400 for body, Geist Mono 500 for labels/metadata
- Roundness: Sharp, squared-off edges (0px globally)
- Elevation: Tonal layering only, no shadows. Depth via surface token shifts.
- Borders: Ghost borders at 15% opacity maximum. No solid borders for sectioning.

**PAGE STRUCTURE:**
1. **Header:** Sticky navigation bar with logo left, sparse menu items right, ghost border bottom
2. **Hero Section:** Asymmetric two-column: headline left (Tasa Orbiter display), data metrics right (KPI cards with Geist Mono)
3. **Features Grid:** 3-column card grid, open-ended cards with left ruling line, surface-container-low backgrounds
4. **Social Proof:** Testimonial strip with monospace attribution and accent highlight
5. **CTA Section:** Full-width dark section with centered headline and gradient primary button
6. **Footer:** Minimal, monospace links, ghost border top

**COMPONENT CONSTRAINTS:**
- Cards must be open-ended (no border on all 4 sides). Use left ruling line only.
- Buttons: 0px radius, Geist Mono uppercase text
- Dead space around accent elements is mandatory

**STATES REQUIRED:**
- Default, Hover, Focus-visible, Disabled
```

### Exemplo 2: Dashboard Card (componente unico)

```markdown
A data-dense KPI card for a premium dashboard, designed for high-information-density display.

**DESIGN SYSTEM (REQUIRED):**
- Platform: Web, Desktop-first
- Theme: Premium, dark, data-first
- Background: Deep Surface (#151517) for card
- Surface: Panel Background (#18181B) for inner sections
- Primary Accent: {accent_name} ({accent_hex}) for highlights and trend indicators
- Text Primary: Cream White (#F4F4F4)
- Text Secondary: Dim Text (rgba(244,244,244,0.52))
- Typography: Space Grotesk 800 for values, Manrope 400 for body, IBM Plex Mono 500 for labels
- Roundness: Slightly softened corners (4px)
- Elevation: Whisper-soft shadow on hover only
- Borders: Subtle border at 9% white opacity

**PAGE STRUCTURE:**
1. **Label:** Monospace uppercase label (0.55rem, tracking wide, dim color)
2. **Value:** Large display number (2rem, bold, primary text)
3. **Trend:** Inline trend indicator with direction arrow and percentage
4. **Sparkline:** Optional mini chart below value

**STATES REQUIRED:**
- Default, Hover (inset glow), Focus-within (accent left border), Loading (skeleton)
```

## Regras de Preenchimento

1. **Vibe line:** SEMPRE 1 frase. Nunca um paragrafo. Descrever mood + purpose.
2. **Cores:** SEMPRE no formato "Nome Descritivo (hex) for role". Nunca so hex.
3. **Tipografia:** SEMPRE incluir peso (400, 700, 800). Nunca so o nome da font.
4. **Roundness/Depth:** SEMPRE consultar `design-mappings.yaml`. Nunca inventar termos.
5. **Page Structure:** MINIMO 3 secoes. Cada secao com nome bold + descricao.
6. **Se o DS ativo nao tem algum token:** Usar valor do tema default ou perguntar ao usuario.

---

## Bloco de Negative Constraints (OBRIGATORIO)

Pesquisa mostra que constraints negativos sao mais eficazes que positivos para consistencia de design em LLMs (Gemini, Claude, GPT). SEMPRE incluir este bloco no prompt final.

```markdown
**CONSTRAINTS (MUST NOT):**
- NUNCA usar cores hardcoded (hex/rgb direto). SEMPRE var(--token).
- NUNCA usar inline styles. SEMPRE Tailwind classes ou CSS custom properties.
- NUNCA inventar tokens que nao existem no DESIGN SYSTEM acima.
- NUNCA omitir responsive. Mobile-first com breakpoints md: e lg:.
- NUNCA omitir estados (hover, focus-visible, disabled).
{{additional_negative_constraints}}
```

### Quando adicionar constraints extras

| Estetica | Constraint adicional |
|----------|---------------------|
| Brutalist | "NUNCA usar border-radius > 0px" |
| Brutalist | "NUNCA usar sombras. Profundidade via tonal layering APENAS" |
| Brutalist | "NUNCA usar borders solidos para separacao. Usar shift de background" |
| Editorial | "NUNCA centralizar todos os elementos. Usar assimetria intencional" |
| Brandbook | "NUNCA usar cores fora do namespace bb-*" |
| Premium | "NUNCA usar mais de 2 cores accent" |

---

## Bloco de Few-Shot Examples (RECOMENDADO)

Pesquisa Google (2026) confirma: 2-3 few-shot examples superam instrucoes textuais longas para consistencia. RECOMENDADO incluir 1-2 exemplos de componentes existentes no prompt.

### Formato de few-shot

```markdown
**REFERENCE COMPONENTS (match this pattern):**

Example 1 - {{component_name}}:
```tsx
{{component_code_snippet}}
```

Example 2 - {{component_name}}:
```tsx
{{component_code_snippet}}
```
```

### Regras para selecao de few-shot

1. Escolher componentes do MESMO nivel atomico que o pedido (atom para atom, molecule para molecule)
2. Escolher componentes do MESMO design system ativo
3. Maximo 2 exemplos (mais que 3 causa overfitting no Gemini)
4. Incluir pattern completo: imports, interface, component, export
5. Se nao existem componentes gerados ainda, usar os exemplos deste template

---

## Adaptacao para Plataformas Externas

### Google AI Studio / Gemini

Ao usar este template para gerar output no Gemini (AI Studio):

1. **System Instruction:** Colocar `<role>`, `<stack>`, `<constraints>` e `<design-tokens>` no campo System Instruction (delimitado com XML tags)
2. **Primeira mensagem:** Colar 2 few-shot examples como primeira mensagem do chat
3. **Prompt de pagina:** Usar o template preenchido + screenshot como segunda mensagem
4. **Uma pagina por conversa.** Re-colar system instruction a cada nova sessao
5. **Temperature:** Manter padrao (1.0 no Gemini 3). Nao reduzir

### Lovable / Bolt / v0

1. **Upload do projeto:** Se possivel, enviar ZIP do starter standalone
2. **Prompt unico:** Colar template preenchido + screenshot + constraints no mesmo prompt
3. **Iteracao:** Usar o bloco "Update Delicado" de `prompt-templates-library.md` para ajustes

### Claude Code / AIOX

1. **Automatico:** O pipeline `ds-enhance-prompt` preenche este template automaticamente
2. **Manual:** O agente @brad-frost ou @design-chief preenche antes de executar
3. **DS ativo:** Carregado via `*show-context` (design-chief) ou config.yaml (automatico)

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://sinkra.dev/schemas/design-md.schema.json",
  "title": "DESIGN.md Frontmatter",
  "description": "JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a design.md scaffold per ADR-022 (alias-preserved 5-layer token contract). Reference: apps/design/src/data/designs/anthropic/design.md (gold standard, 256 values). Schema versioning is git-tracked; the file name carries no version suffix.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "required": [
    "version",
    "name",
    "colors"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^2\\.\\d+$",
      "description": "Schema version. v2.2 is the current canonical."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Brand or design system display name."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "One-line summary of the visual atmosphere."
    },
    "defaultMode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["light", "dark"],
      "description": "Which mode the brand renders by default. Falls back to 'light' if unspecified."
    },
    "supportsDark": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "True when the brand ships dedicated dark-mode tokens. Required for dark: block to be consumed by renderers."
    },
    "archetype": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Free-form archetype label (e.g. 'Warm Editorial · Slate-on-Ivory'). Editorial choice."
    },
    "chips": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string" },
      "description": "Short bullets surfaced in gallery cards. Editorial."
    },
    "consumer_contract": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Hard-coded pipeline policy (priority_order, mode_rule, etc.) per ADR-022 — not extracted from CSS.",
      "properties": {
        "standalone": { "type": "boolean" },
        "goal": { "type": "string" },
        "priority_order": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string" }

        "mode_rule": { "type": "string" },
        "font_rule": { "type": "string" },

        "accessibility_rule": { "type": "string" }
      },
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "colors": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Layer 1 (shadcn slots) + Layer 5 (brand primitives) + Layer 4 aliases. Values are literal hex/rgb/hsl strings.",
      "properties": {

          "letterSpacing": { "oneOf": [{ "type": "string" }, { "type": "number" }] },

      "type": "object",
      "description": "Layer 3 Tailwind base spacing scale. Numeric stops or t-shirt aliases (xs, sm, md, lg, xl). Values may be bare lengths (12px / 1rem) or composite expressions (calc / max / min / clamp).",

        "type": "string",
        "anyOf": [
          { "pattern": "^[0-9.]+(px|rem|em|vh|vw|%)$" },
          { "pattern": "^(calc|max|min|clamp)\\(" },

      }
    },

      "type": "object",
      "description": "Border-radius scale. Numeric or named (none, sm, md, lg, xl, full, button, card, input).",

    },
    "shadows": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Box-shadow scale. Filtered to elevation shadows (no focus rings, no all-transparent).",

    "shadows_inset": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Inset shadows used as hairline borders (Linear/Anthropic pattern). Optional — emitted only when distinct from elevation shadows.",
      "additionalProperties": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "motion": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Layer 2 Fluentui canonical scale. 8 durations + 7 easings + role aliases.",
      "additionalProperties": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "elevation": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "M3-style elevation tiers (flat, raised, floating, overlay, modal). Each value is a box-shadow string.",

    },
    "components": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Component recipes (button-primary, card, input-text, badge, nav-header, etc.). Layer 1 contract.",
      "additionalProperties": {

        "properties": {

            "type": ["string", "null"],
            "enum": ["atom", "molecule", "organism", "layout", "page", "pattern", null]
          },

            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^extraction_gap\\(.+\\)$"
          },
          "atomic_layer_reasoning": { "type": "string" }
        },
        "additionalProperties": true
      }
    },
    "pattern_tokens": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Cross-component pattern tokens such as motion, focus, elevation, and z-index scale. Values must be extracted/aliased evidence or explicit extraction gaps.",
      "properties": {
        "motion": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": { "type": "string" } },
        "motion_gap": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^extraction_gap\\(.+\\)$" },
        "focus": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": { "type": "string" } },
        "focus_gap": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^extraction_gap\\(.+\\)$" },
        "elevation": { "type": ["object", "null"], "additionalProperties": { "type": "string" } },

          "additionalProperties": { "type": ["string", "number"] }
        },
        "z_index_scale_gap": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^extraction_gap\\(.+\\)$" }
      },
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "preview_tokens": {
      "type": "object",

    },
    "brand_primitives": {

    "aliases": {

    },
    "assets": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Brand identity assets extracted from the source page: logo (svg-inline or URL), favicon, og-image, apple-touch-icon, theme-color, manifest URL. Optional — emitted only when extraction yielded any signal.",
      "properties": {

        "favicon":          { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": true },
        "og_image":         { "type": "string" },
        "apple_touch_icon": { "type": "string" },
        "theme_color":      { "type": "string" },
        "manifest_url":     { "type": "string" },
        "twitter_image":    { "type": "string" },
        "twitter_card":     { "type": "string" },
        "twitter_creator":  { "type": "string" },
        "canonical_url":    { "type": "string" }
      },
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "showcase": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Hero block + voice signals consumed by the gallery card renderer.",
      "properties": {
        "headline":     { "type": "string" },
        "headlineHtml": { "type": "string" },
        "kicker":       { "type": "string" },
        "lead":         { "type": "string" },
        "ctas": {
          "type": "array",

            "additionalProperties": true
          }
        },
        "layout": { "type": "string", "enum": ["split", "centered", "stacked", "default"] }
      },
      "additionalProperties": true
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "colorValue": {

        {
          "type": "string",

## Referência: references/squad/templates/display-title.tsx.tmpl

```text
/**
 * DisplayTitle — monumental SVG title that fills 100% of its container
 * on a single line, regardless of word length or viewport width.
 *
 * USE WHEN: editorial "divider-page" surfaces with a single large word
 * (POSICIONAMENTO, ARQUITETURA, ESSÊNCIA). If your title has multiple
 * lines/<br/>, DO NOT use this — use an <h1>/<h2> with clamp font-size
 * and `overflow-wrap: anywhere`.
 *
 * How it works:
 *   - SVG `viewBox` defines aspect ratio; CSS `width="100%"` scales it.
 *   - `textLength` + `lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"` forces glyphs to
 *     span the full inline length — no wrap, no overflow, ever.
 *   - Intrinsic width is calibrated from char count × ~0.56 em (avg for
 *     a typical Grotesk uppercase), so short words aren't tiny and long
 *     words don't need shrinking per-character.
 *
 * Replaces the forbidden pattern:
 *   <h2 style={{ fontSize: "clamp(6rem, 14vw, 18rem)" }}>POSICIONAMENTO</h2>
 * which breaks the viewport on narrow screens.
 *
 * Contract owner: squads/design-ops/rules/responsive-first-contract.md §3
 */

export function DisplayTitle({
  text,
  color = "currentColor",
  fontFamily = "var(--font-display)",
  fontWeight = 400,
}: {
  text: string;
  color?: string;
  fontFamily?: string;
  fontWeight?: number;
}) {
  const fontSize = 100;   // SVG-local units; viewBox scaling controls real size
  const perChar = 56;     // ≈0.56em for typical Grotesk caps; tune per face
  const padding = 20;
  const intrinsicWidth = Math.max(200, text.length * perChar + padding * 2);
  const baseline = 78;    // ascender baseline inside a 100-unit cap-height

  return (
    <svg
      role="img"
      aria-label={text}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${intrinsicWidth} ${fontSize}`}
      preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
      width="100%"
      style={{ display: "block", maxWidth: "100%", overflow: "visible" }}
    >
      <text
        x="50%"
        y={baseline}
        fill={color}
        textAnchor="middle"
        fontFamily={fontFamily}
        fontSize={fontSize}
        fontWeight={fontWeight}
        letterSpacing="-2"
        textLength={intrinsicWidth - padding * 2}
        lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"
      >
        {text}
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
}
```

## Referência: references/squad/templates/ds-migration-strategy-tmpl.md

# Migration Strategy: {{PROJECT_NAME}}

**Generated:** {{GENERATION_DATE}}
**Project:** {{PROJECT_NAME}}
**Current Patterns:** {{TOTAL_PATTERNS_BEFORE}}
**Target Patterns:** {{TOTAL_PATTERNS_AFTER}}
**Reduction:** {{REDUCTION_PERCENTAGE}}%

---

## Executive Summary

This migration strategy consolidates **{{TOTAL_PATTERNS_BEFORE}} UI patterns** into **{{TOTAL_PATTERNS_AFTER}} standardized components**, achieving a **{{REDUCTION_PERCENTAGE}}% reduction** in maintenance burden.

**Key Outcomes:**
- 💰 **{{ANNUAL_SAVINGS}}/year** in maintenance savings
- ⚡ **{{VELOCITY_IMPROVEMENT}}x** faster feature development
- 🎯 **{{CONSOLIDATION_IMPACT}}** reduction in code surface area
- 📅 **{{TOTAL_TIMELINE}}** phased rollout timeline

**Risk Level:** Low - Phased approach minimizes disruption

---

## Migration Philosophy

1. **No Big-Bang Rewrites** - Gradual, phase-by-phase rollout
2. **Foundation First** - Token system deploys before visual changes
3. **High-Impact Priority** - Replace most-used patterns first for immediate ROI
4. **Rollback Ready** - Each phase independently reversible
5. **Measured Progress** - Metrics tracked at every stage

---

## Phase 1: Foundation

### Goal
Deploy token system with **zero visual changes**. Establish foundation for all future work.

### Prerequisites
- [x] Design tokens extracted and validated
- [ ] Token files added to repository
- [ ] Build pipeline configured for token processing
- [ ] Development team trained on token usage

### Tasks

#### 1.1 Token System Deployment
- [ ] Add `tokens.yaml` to `{{TOKEN_DIRECTORY}}`
- [ ] Generate multi-format exports (JSON, CSS, Tailwind, SCSS)
- [ ] Configure build pipeline to process tokens
- [ ] Validate token imports work in development environment

#### 1.2 Existing CSS Token Migration (Automated)
- [ ] Run automated CSS variable replacement script
- [ ] Replace hardcoded colors with `var(--color-*)` references
- [ ] Replace hardcoded spacing with `var(--space-*)` references
- [ ] Replace hardcoded typography with `var(--font-*)` references

#### 1.3 Validation & Testing
- [ ] Visual regression tests pass (no UI changes)
- [ ] Build succeeds with token system integrated
- [ ] Development environment loads correctly
- [ ] Production build size unchanged or reduced

### Timeline
**Duration:** {{PHASE_1_DURATION}}
**Effort:** {{PHASE_1_EFFORT}} developer-hours

### Risk Assessment
**Risk Level:** 🟢 Low

**Risks:**
- Build pipeline integration issues
- Token naming conflicts with existing variables

**Mitigation:**
- Namespace tokens with `ds-` prefix if conflicts occur
- Incremental rollout (development → staging → production)
- Rollback procedure: Revert commit, restore previous CSS

### Success Criteria
- ✅ Tokens deployed to all environments
- ✅ Zero visual regressions detected
- ✅ Build pipeline stable
- ✅ No user-facing changes

### Rollback Procedure
```bash
# If issues detected, rollback immediately
git revert {{PHASE_1_COMMIT_HASH}}
npm run build
npm run deploy
```

---

**Duration:** {{PHASE_4_DURATION}}

**Risks:**

- False positives blocking legitimate work
- Metrics dashboard not maintained

**Mitigation:**

- Fine-tune linter rules based on feedback
- Assign ownership of metrics dashboard

### Success Criteria

- ✅ Zero non-system patterns merged to main
- ✅ 100% of new components use design system
- ✅ Team reports confidence in system

## Rollback Procedures

**Phase 1 Rollback:**
```bash
git revert {{PHASE_1_COMMIT_HASH}}
npm run build && npm run deploy
```

**Phase 2 Rollback (per component):**
```bash
# Revert specific component migration
git revert {{COMPONENT_MIGRATION_COMMIT}}
npm run test && npm run deploy
```

**Phase 3 Rollback:**
```bash
# Revert long-tail cleanup
git revert {{PHASE_3_START_COMMIT}}..{{PHASE_3_END_COMMIT}}
npm run build && npm run deploy
```

**Phase 4 Rollback:**
```bash
# Disable enforcement
git revert {{ENFORCEMENT_COMMIT}}

### Emergency Rollback (Full System)

project_name: "{{project_name}}"

  phase: "{{current_phase}}"  # audit_complete | consolidation_complete | tokenize_complete | migration_strategy_complete | setup_complete | building_components

    scanned_at: "{{scan_timestamp}}"

      react: "{{has_react}}"
      vue: "{{has_vue}}"
      html: "{{has_html}}"
    patterns:
      buttons:
        unique: "{{buttons_unique}}"
        instances: "{{buttons_instances}}"

      colors:
        unique: "{{colors_unique}}"
        instances: "{{colors_instances}}"
        redundancy_factor: "{{colors_redundancy}}"

        unique_padding: "{{spacing_padding}}"

      colors:

        before: "{{buttons_before}}"
        after: "{{buttons_after}}"
        reduction: "{{buttons_reduction}}%"

      spacing:
        before: "{{spacing_before}}"
        after: "{{spacing_after}}"
        reduction: "{{spacing_reduction}}%"
        scale: "{{spacing_scale}}"

        before: "{{typography_before}}"
        after: "{{typography_after}}"
        reduction: "{{typography_reduction}}%"
    overall_reduction: "{{overall_reduction}}%"
    target_met: "{{target_met}}"
    user_overrides: "{{user_overrides}}"

  # Phase 3: Tokenization (Brad)

      - tokens.yaml

    categories:

    before:
      patterns: "{{patterns_before}}"

    after:

    savings:
      monthly: "{{monthly_savings}}"
      annual: "{{annual_savings}}"
    implementation:
      estimated_cost: "{{implementation_cost}}"
    roi_metrics:
      ratio: "{{roi_ratio}}"

  migration:

      - phase: 1

## Referência: references/squad/templates/ds-tokens-defaults-tmpl.yaml

```yaml
template_name: "Design Tokens Schema (Hydrated Defaults)"
template_version: "1.0.0"
output_format: "yaml"
destination: "workspace/businesses/{biz}/L2-tactical/design/tokens.yaml"
description: |
  Hydrated DTCG token schema with justified default values for sinkra-hub
  business onboarding. Cross-validated against 8 reference DS:
  Polaris, Carbon, Primer, Mantine, ChakraUI, shadcn/ui, Ant Design,
  HeroUI. Replaces empty placeholder template (`tokens-schema-tmpl.yaml`).

# =============================================================================
# Justification Matrix — How defaults were chosen
# =============================================================================
# spacing      : 5-step (xs/sm/md/lg/xl) — Mantine + HeroUI + Polaris narrowed
# font_sizes   : 8-step (xs..4xl) — Tailwind/Primer/Chakra majority
# font_weights : 4-step (regular/medium/semibold/bold) — Mantine + shadcn
# radius       : 7-step (none..full) — Chakra/shadcn balanced
# durations    : 3-step (fast/base/slow) — pragmatic median; Chakra 7-step is overkill
# breakpoints  : 5-step (mobile..ultrawide) — modern web 2026; Tailwind v4 compat
# z-index      : 6-step (dropdown..tooltip) — Primer ascending pattern
# color_space  : oklch — shadcn 2024+ standard, perceptually uniform
# theming      : data-attribute (data-theme="dark") + .dark class — shadcn pattern
# =============================================================================

metadata:
  version: "1.0.0"
  generated_by: "design-ops"
  generated_at: "{{timestamp}}"
  dtcg_spec: "2025.10"
  color_space: "oklch"
  source_ds_references:
    - polaris-tokens (Shopify) — 2026-04
    - carbon (IBM) — 2026-04
    - primer-primitives (GitHub) — 2026-04
    - mantine — 2026-04
    - chakra-ui (Panda preset) — 2026-04
    - shadcn-ui (Tailwind v4 + oklch) — 2026-04
    - ant-design (seed tokens) — 2026-04
    - heroui — 2026-04
  hydration_strategy: "median-justified"
  coverage: "{{coverage_percentage}}%"
  business_slug: "{{biz}}"

layers:
  # ============================================================================
  # LAYER 1: CORE / PRIMITIVES — raw values, descriptive names
  # Reference: shadcn (oklch values), Mantine (5-step scales), Primer (size scale)
  # ============================================================================
  core:
    color:
      "$type": "color"
      "$description": "Raw color primitives — never used directly by components"

      # Neutrals — 11 steps for grayscale precision
      # Source: shadcn oklch + Mantine 10-step gray
      neutral-0:
        "$value": "oklch(1 0 0)"  # #ffffff
        "$description": "Pure white — base canvas"
      neutral-50:
        "$value": "oklch(0.985 0 0)"  # ~#fafafa
        "$description": "Lightest neutral — subtle backgrounds"
      neutral-100:
        "$value": "oklch(0.97 0 0)"   # ~#f4f4f5
      neutral-200:
        "$value": "oklch(0.922 0 0)"  # ~#e4e4e7 — common border
      neutral-300:
        "$value": "oklch(0.85 0 0)"   # ~#d4d4d8
      neutral-400:
        "$value": "oklch(0.708 0 0)"  # ~#a1a1aa — disabled fg
      neutral-500:
        "$value": "oklch(0.556 0 0)"  # ~#71717a — muted fg
      neutral-600:
        "$value": "oklch(0.4 0 0)"    # ~#52525b
      neutral-700:
        "$value": "oklch(0.3 0 0)"    # ~#3f3f46
      neutral-800:
        "$value": "oklch(0.205 0 0)"  # ~#27272a — primary surface dark
      neutral-900:
        "$value": "oklch(0.145 0 0)"  # ~#18181b — pure dark canvas
      neutral-1000:
        "$value": "oklch(0 0 0)"      # #000000 — pure black

      # Brand accent slots — defaults are shadcn-neutral, OVERRIDE per business
      accent-primary:
        "$value": "oklch(0.205 0 0)"   # ~#27272a (neutral-800) — shadcn default
        "$description": |
          Primary brand hue. Default is shadcn-neutral (near-black) for safe fallback.
          OVERRIDE per business in workspace/businesses/{biz}/L2-tactical/design/tokens.yaml.
          Examples: AIOS lime "oklch(0.85 0.18 130)", Bilhon orange "oklch(0.7 0.18 50)".
      accent-secondary:
        "$value": "oklch(0.97 0 0)"    # ~#f4f4f5 (neutral-100) — shadcn default
        "$description": |
          Supporting brand hue. Default is neutral-100 (subtle surface accent).
          OVERRIDE per business; commonly used for tags, secondary buttons, soft callouts.

      # Semantic accents — DTCG-style, sourced from Ant + Tailwind
      accent-success:
        "$value": "oklch(0.696 0.17 162.48)"  # green ~#10b981
      accent-warning:
        "$value": "oklch(0.769 0.188 70.08)"  # amber ~#f59e0b
      accent-error:
        "$value": "oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)" # red ~#dc2626
      accent-info:
        "$value": "oklch(0.6 0.118 184.704)"  # cyan ~#0891b2

    spacing:
      "$type": "dimension"
      "$description": "5-step named scale + 4px base unit (Tailwind compat)"
      # Source: Mantine + HeroUI majority pattern; Polaris uses similar named system
      base-unit:
        "$value": "0.25rem"  # 4px — Tailwind base
        "$description": "Atomic unit; multiply for raw access"
      none:
        "$value": "0"
      xs:
        "$value": "0.5rem"   # 8px  — Polaris extra-tight
      sm:
        "$value": "0.75rem"  # 12px — Polaris base-tight
      md:
        "$value": "1rem"     # 16px — Polaris base
      lg:
        "$value": "1.5rem"   # 24px — between Polaris loose/extra-loose
      xl:
        "$value": "2rem"     # 32px — Polaris extra-loose
      "2xl":
        "$value": "3rem"     # 48px
      "3xl":
        "$value": "4rem"     # 64px

    typography:
      "$type": "typography"
      font-base:
        "$value":
          family: '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif'
        "$description": "System font stack — Polaris/Ant/Mantine consensus"
      font-heading:
        "$value":
          family: "{core.typography.font-base}"
        "$description": |
          Heading font. Default = same as font-base (single-family system).
          OVERRIDE per business if brand uses dedicated display typeface
          (e.g., AIOX uses Geist, Bilhon uses Recoleta).
      font-mono:
        "$value":
          family: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace'
        "$description": "Mono stack — Mantine consensus"

      sizes:
        "$type": "dimension"
        "$description": "8-step scale; xs..4xl. Source: Tailwind/Primer/Chakra alignment"
        xs:
          "$value": "0.75rem"   # 12px
          "$description": "Captions, badges, dense UI"
        sm:
          "$value": "0.875rem"  # 14px
          "$description": "Default body for dense layouts"
        base:
          "$value": "1rem"      # 16px
          "$description": "Default body — accessibility minimum"
        lg:
          "$value": "1.125rem"  # 18px
          "$description": "Large body, small headings"
        xl:
          "$value": "1.25rem"   # 20px
          "$description": "Subheadings"
        "2xl":
          "$value": "1.5rem"    # 24px — h3 typical
        "3xl":
          "$value": "1.875rem"  # 30px — h2 typical
        "4xl":
          "$value": "2.25rem"   # 36px — h1 typical

      weights:
        "$type": "number"
        "$description": "4-step scale — Mantine median; shadcn-compat"
        regular:
          "$value": 400
        medium:
          "$value": 500
        semibold:
          "$value": 600
        bold:
          "$value": 700

      line-height:
        "$type": "number"
        tight:
          "$value": 1.25
          "$description": "Headings; Mantine xs equivalent"
        normal:
          "$value": 1.5
          "$description": "Default body — accessibility recommendation"
        relaxed:
          "$value": 1.75
          "$description": "Long-form reading; Mantine xl equivalent"

      letter-spacing:
        "$type": "dimension"
        tight:
          "$value": "-0.025em"
        normal:
          "$value": "0"
        wide:
          "$value": "0.025em"

    radius:
      "$type": "dimension"
      "$description": "7-step Chakra/shadcn alignment"
      none:
        "$value": "0"
      sm:
        "$value": "0.25rem"  # 4px — Mantine sm
      base:
        "$value": "0.375rem" # 6px — Chakra md (default radius)
      md:
        "$value": "0.5rem"   # 8px — Mantine md
      lg:
        "$value": "0.75rem"  # 12px — Chakra xl
      xl:
        "$value": "1rem"     # 16px — Mantine lg
      "2xl":
        "$value": "1.5rem"   # 24px
      full:
        "$value": "9999px"
        "$description": "Pills, avatars, fully rounded"

    shadow:
      "$type": "shadow"
      "$description": "5-step elevation; Tailwind/Mantine consensus"
      none:
        "$value": "none"
      sm:
        "$value": "0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)"
        "$description": "Subtle separation — input focus, hover"
      base:
        "$value": "0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)"
        "$description": "Cards at rest"
      md:
        "$value": "0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)"
        "$description": "Dropdowns, popovers"
      lg:
        "$value": "0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)"
        "$description": "Modals, dialogs"
      xl:
        "$value": "0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)"
        "$description": "Notifications, toasts"

    duration:
      "$type": "duration"
      "$description": "3-step pragmatic; Chakra 7-step is overkill for sinkra apps"
      instant:
        "$value": "0ms"
      fast:
        "$value": "150ms"
        "$description": "Hover, focus, micro-interactions"
      base:
        "$value": "250ms"
        "$description": "Most transitions — Mantine consensus"
      slow:
        "$value": "350ms"
        "$description": "Modals, page transitions"

    easing:
      "$type": "cubic-bezier"
      linear:
        "$value": "linear"
      in:
        "$value": "cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)"
      out:
        "$value": "cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)"
        "$description": "Default — Material/Mantine standard"
      in-out:
        "$value": "cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"

    breakpoint:
      "$type": "dimension"
      "$description": "5-step modern web 2026; Tailwind v4 + shadcn alignment"
      mobile:
        "$value": "640px"     # sm — Tailwind
      tablet:
        "$value": "768px"     # md — Tailwind
      desktop:
        "$value": "1024px"    # lg — Tailwind
      wide:
        "$value": "1280px"    # xl — Tailwind
      ultrawide:
        "$value": "1536px"    # 2xl — Tailwind

    z-index:
      "$type": "number"
      "$description": "Ascending; Primer 100-step pattern collapsed to 6 layers"
      base:
        "$value": 0
      dropdown:
        "$value": 1000
      sticky:
        "$value": 1100
      fixed:
        "$value": 1200
      modal-backdrop:
        "$value": 1300
      modal:
        "$value": 1300
      popover:
        "$value": 1400
      tooltip:
        "$value": 1500

  # ============================================================================
  # LAYER 2: SEMANTIC — meaning-driven aliases
  # Reference: shadcn semantic mapping (--background → --color-background)
  # ============================================================================
  semantic:
    color:
      "$type": "color"
      "$description": "Light theme defaults; dark variant in :root[data-theme=dark]"

      # Surfaces
      background:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-0}"
        "$description": "Page canvas"
      foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-900}"
        "$description": "Primary text on background"
      surface:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-50}"
        "$description": "Cards, raised surfaces"
      surface-foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-900}"

      # Brand
      primary:
        "$value": "{core.color.accent-primary}"
      primary-foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-0}"
        "$description": "Text on primary — assumes dark primary"
      secondary:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-100}"
      secondary-foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-900}"

      # States
      muted:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-100}"
      muted-foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-500}"
      accent:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-100}"
      accent-foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-900}"
      destructive:
        "$value": "{core.color.accent-error}"
      destructive-foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-0}"

      # Borders & inputs
      border:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-200}"
      input:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-200}"
      ring:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-400}"
        "$description": "Focus ring color — WCAG 2.4.7"

      # Semantic states
      success:
        "$value": "{core.color.accent-success}"
      success-foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-0}"
      warning:
        "$value": "{core.color.accent-warning}"
      warning-foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-900}"
      error:
        "$value": "{core.color.accent-error}"
      error-foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-0}"
      info:
        "$value": "{core.color.accent-info}"
      info-foreground:
        "$value": "{core.color.neutral-0}"

    spacing:
      "$type": "dimension"
      "$description": "Inset/stack/gap aliases. Apps use these, not core.spacing"
      inset-xs:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.xs}"
      inset-sm:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.sm}"
      inset-md:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.md}"
      inset-lg:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.lg}"
      inset-xl:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.xl}"
      stack-tight:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.sm}"
      stack-normal:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.md}"
      stack-loose:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.lg}"

    typography:
      "$type": "typography"
      body:
        "$value":
          family: "{core.typography.font-base}"
          size: "{core.typography.sizes.base}"
          lineHeight: "{core.typography.line-height.normal}"
          weight: "{core.typography.weights.regular}"
      body-strong:
        "$value":
          family: "{core.typography.font-base}"
          size: "{core.typography.sizes.base}"
          lineHeight: "{core.typography.line-height.normal}"
          weight: "{core.typography.weights.semibold}"
      heading-1:
        "$value":
          family: "{core.typography.font-heading}"
          size: "{core.typography.sizes.4xl}"
          lineHeight: "{core.typography.line-height.tight}"
          weight: "{core.typography.weights.bold}"
      heading-2:
        "$value":
          family: "{core.typography.font-heading}"
          size: "{core.typography.sizes.3xl}"
          lineHeight: "{core.typography.line-height.tight}"
          weight: "{core.typography.weights.bold}"
      heading-3:
        "$value":
          family: "{core.typography.font-heading}"
          size: "{core.typography.sizes.2xl}"
          lineHeight: "{core.typography.line-height.tight}"
          weight: "{core.typography.weights.semibold}"
      caption:
        "$value":
          family: "{core.typography.font-base}"
          size: "{core.typography.sizes.sm}"
          lineHeight: "{core.typography.line-height.normal}"
          weight: "{core.typography.weights.regular}"
      code:
        "$value":
          family: "{core.typography.font-mono}"
          size: "{core.typography.sizes.sm}"
          lineHeight: "{core.typography.line-height.normal}"
          weight: "{core.typography.weights.regular}"

    motion:
      "$type": "duration"
      micro:
        "$value": "{core.duration.fast}"
        "$description": "Hover, focus, button press"
      transition:
        "$value": "{core.duration.base}"
        "$description": "Default state changes"
      enter:
        "$value": "{core.duration.slow}"
        "$description": "Modals, drawers, page transitions"

  # ============================================================================
  # LAYER 3: COMPONENT — slot-specific overrides
  # Reference: Primer functional tokens; Carbon component tokens
  # Only ESSENTIAL slots; component-specific theming via shadcn-style class
  # ============================================================================
  component:
    button:
      "$type": "object"
      "$description": "Button slots. shadcn-compat: text/bg/border/ring."
      primary:
        background:
          "$value": "{semantic.color.primary}"
        background-hover:
          "$value": "{semantic.color.primary}"
          "$description": "Apps may filter via opacity-90"
        text:
          "$value": "{semantic.color.primary-foreground}"
        border-radius:
          "$value": "{core.radius.md}"
        padding-inline:
          "$value": "{core.spacing.md}"
        padding-block:
          "$value": "{core.spacing.sm}"
        font-weight:
          "$value": "{core.typography.weights.medium}"
      secondary:
        background:
          "$value": "{semantic.color.secondary}"
        text:
          "$value": "{semantic.color.secondary-foreground}"
        border:
          "$value": "{semantic.color.border}"
      ghost:
        background:
          "$value": "transparent"
        text:
          "$value": "{semantic.color.foreground}"
        background-hover:
          "$value": "{semantic.color.muted}"
      destructive:
        background:
          "$value": "{semantic.color.destructive}"
        text:
          "$value": "{semantic.color.destructive-foreground}"

    input:
      "$type": "object"
      background:
        "$value": "{semantic.color.background}"
      text:
        "$value": "{semantic.color.foreground}"
      placeholder:
        "$value": "{semantic.color.muted-foreground}"
      border:
        "$value": "{semantic.color.input}"
      border-focus:
        "$value": "{semantic.color.ring}"
      border-radius:
        "$value": "{core.radius.md}"
      padding-inline:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.sm}"
      padding-block:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.sm}"

    card:
      "$type": "object"
      background:
        "$value": "{semantic.color.surface}"
      foreground:
        "$value": "{semantic.color.surface-foreground}"
      border:
        "$value": "{semantic.color.border}"
      border-radius:
        "$value": "{core.radius.lg}"
      padding:
        "$value": "{core.spacing.lg}"
      shadow:
        "$value": "{core.shadow.base}"

# =============================================================================
# THEME OVERRIDES
# Pattern: shadcn data-attribute (data-theme=dark) + .dark class
# Applies ONLY to semantic layer; core layer is theme-invariant
# =============================================================================
themes:
  dark:
    "$description": "Dark mode overrides — applied via [data-theme=dark] or .dark class"
    semantic:
      color:
        background:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-900}"
        foreground:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-50}"
        surface:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-800}"
        surface-foreground:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-50}"
        muted:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-700}"
        muted-foreground:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-400}"
        accent:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-700}"
        accent-foreground:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-50}"
        secondary:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-800}"
        secondary-foreground:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-50}"
        border:
          "$value": "oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)"
          "$description": "Translucent border — shadcn pattern for dark"
        input:
          "$value": "oklch(1 0 0 / 15%)"
        ring:
          "$value": "{core.color.neutral-500}"

# =============================================================================
# EXPORTS — Style Dictionary outputs
# =============================================================================
exports:
  yaml: tokens.yaml
  json: tokens.json
  dtcg: tokens.dtcg.json        # W3C DTCG strict format
  css: tokens.css                # raw :root CSS vars
  tailwind_v4: globals.css       # @theme inline mapping
  scss: tokens.scss
  ts: tokens.ts                  # TS object for runtime consumption

# =============================================================================
# CONSUMERS
# Apps that use this schema. Updated when business onboards.
# =============================================================================
consumers:
  - apps/redpine-ds      # if biz=allfluence
  - apps/aiox-brandbook  # if biz=aiox
  - apps/anthropic-ds

## Referência: references/squad/templates/focus-indicators-global.css.tmpl

```text
/* Focus indicators — WCAG 2.2 AAA compliant (RHDS spec).
   =========================================================
   Inject this block into apps/{target}/src/app/globals.css.
   Dropped by scaffold-ds.sh.

   Three non-negotiable rules:
   1. `:is(*, :hover):focus-visible` — prevents hover state canceling focus ring
   2. `outline: 3px solid` + `outline-offset: 3px` — WCAG 2.2 AAA minimum
   3. `transition: none` — focus appears instantly (non-distracting for a11y)
   4. `:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none }` — only keyboard shows ring

   Origin: Red Hat Design System foundations/interactions/focus-indicators.
   Documented in: squads/design-ops/rules/extension-vocabulary-match.md (absorb contracts section)
*/

:is(*, :hover):focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus, var(--ds-accent, currentColor));
  outline-offset: 3px;
  transition: none;
}

:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: none;
}
```

<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
  Template: html-artifact-tmpl
  Version:  1.0.0
  Owner:    design-ops
  Consumed by: squads/design-ops/tasks/artifact-create-html.md
  Contract: squads/design-ops/data/artifact-file-governance.yaml
  Security: squads/design-ops/rules/self-contained-artifact-security.md

  Replace {{ placeholders }} with brief-resolved values at emit time.
  Keep inline tokens (no var(--name) references — copy-first model).
  All CDN scripts MUST carry integrity + crossorigin when used.
  Do NOT introduce eval, document.write, or new Function.
-->
<html lang="{{ lang | default: 'pt-BR' }}">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="description" content="{{ description }}" />
  <meta name="generator" content="design-ops/artifact-create-html@1.0.0" />
  <meta name="artifact-id" content="{{ artifact_id }}" />
  <meta name="business" content="{{ business }}" />
  <title>{{ title }}</title>

  <!-- Inline tokens resolved at emit time from ds-context.yaml (copy-first) -->
  <style>
    :root {
      /* Colors — replace with exact hex from ds-context */
      --color-primary: {{ tokens.color_primary }};
      --color-surface: {{ tokens.color_surface }};
      --color-text: {{ tokens.color_text }};
      --color-muted: {{ tokens.color_muted }};
      --color-border: {{ tokens.color_border }};

      /* Typography — replace with exact values */
      --font-sans: {{ tokens.font_sans }};
      --font-size-body: {{ tokens.font_size_body }};
      --line-height-body: {{ tokens.line_height_body }};

      /* Spacing — replace with exact values */
      --space-1: {{ tokens.space_1 }};
      --space-2: {{ tokens.space_2 }};
      --space-3: {{ tokens.space_3 }};
      --space-4: {{ tokens.space_4 }};

      /* Radii + elevation */
      --radius-md: {{ tokens.radius_md }};
      --shadow-card: {{ tokens.shadow_card }};
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: var(--font-size-body);
      line-height: var(--line-height-body);
      color: var(--color-text);
      background: var(--color-surface);
    }

    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    /* Responsive — narrowest target from brief.audience.device_mix */
    @media (max-width: 360px) {
      html { font-size: 14px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- Artifact content goes here; kebab-case slug on the root node is conventional -->
  <main id="{{ artifact_slug }}-root" data-artifact-id="{{ artifact_id }}">
    <!-- Emitter fills this with brief-resolved markup.
         Keep under ~1000 lines per artifact-file-governance#size_limits.
         Split into external assets if exceeded. -->
  </main>

  <!--
    OPTIONAL: Tweak Protocol instrumentation
    Only include when brief.tweak_protocol.enabled == true.
    Ordering is critical — see artifact-tweak-protocol.md Step 3.
    Canonical spec: squads/design-ops/data/tweak-protocol-spec.yaml
  -->
  <!-- <script>
    // (1) Defaults with canonical markers — strict JSON between markers
    const TWEAK_DEFAULS = /*EDITMODE-BEGIN*/{
      "primaryColor": "{{ tweak.primary_color }}",
      "dark": false
    }/*EDITMODE-END*/;

    // (2) Namespace everything under __sinkra_designops_tweak_
    window.__sinkra_designops_tweak_state = { panelOpen: false, values: { ...TWEAK_DEFAULS } };

    // (3) Register listener BEFORE announcing availability (#1 failure mode otherwise)
    window.addEventListener("message", (e) => {
      if (e.source !== window.parent) return;
      if (e.data?.type === "__activate_edit_mode") { /* showTweakPanel() */ }
      else if (e.data?.type === "__deactivate_edit_mode") { /* hideTweakPanel() */ }
    });

    // (4) Announce availability AFTER listener is live
    window.parent.postMessage({ type: "__edit_mode_available" }, "*");

    // (5) On in-panel change: apply live + post partial edit to host
    // function onTweakChange(key, value) {
    //   applyLive(key, value);
    //   window.parent.postMessage({ type: "__edit_mode_set_keys", edits: { [key]: value } }, "*");
    // }
  </script> -->

## Referência: references/squad/templates/mobile-topbar.tsx.tmpl

```text
"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Menu } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/sheet";
// Replace `@/components/sidebar` with the actual path to your project's
// nav component that exports a `SidebarNav` (or equivalent) renderable
// inside both the desktop aside and this mobile Sheet.
import { SidebarNav } from "@/components/sidebar";

/**
 * MobileTopBar — canonical mobile navigation for any brandbook, dashboard,
 * or marketing surface generated by /design-system.
 *
 * Contract:
 *   - `lg:hidden` so desktop aside takes over from 1080px.
 *   - SheetTrigger minHeight/minWidth 4.4rem → WCAG 2.2 touch target.
 *   - SheetContent reuses SidebarNav so mobile + desktop stay in lockstep.
 *   - onNavigate={() => setOpen(false)} closes the drawer on link click.
 *
 * This file is a TEMPLATE — copy into apps/{app}/src/components/ and
 * adjust the logo path + SidebarNav import. Do NOT customize the touch-
 * target dimensions without updating responsive-first-contract.md.
 */
export function MobileTopBar({
  logoSrc = "/logo/Preto@2x.png",
  logoAlt = "Brand",
}: {
  logoSrc?: string;
  logoAlt?: string;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div
      className="lg:hidden fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-[500] h-[var(--mobile-topbar-h)] flex items-center justify-between bg-white border-b border-border px-[var(--panel-p-sm)]"
      role="banner"
    >
      <Link href="/" className="no-underline flex items-center">
        <Image
          src={logoSrc}
          alt={logoAlt}
          width={280}
          height={80}
          priority
          className="w-[11rem] h-auto block"
        />
      </Link>

      <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <SheetTrigger
          data-touch-target
          aria-label="Abrir menu de navegação"
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"
        >
          <Menu className="size-6" aria-hidden="true" />
        </SheetTrigger>

        <SheetContent
          side="right"
          className="w-[88vw] max-w-[42rem] overflow-y-auto p-0"
        >
          <SheetTitle className="sr-only">Navegação principal</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription className="sr-only">
            Índice de seções.
          </SheetDescription>
          <SidebarNav onNavigate={() => setOpen(false)} />
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Referência: references/squad/templates/responsive-layout.tsx.tmpl

```text
/**
 * Responsive App Layout — canonical shell for any /design-system artifact
 * that has navigation (brandbook, dashboard, marketing site, app).
 *
 * Pairs `<MobileTopBar />` (renders <lg) with `<Sidebar />` (renders ≥lg).
 * Both surfaces share nav content via `SidebarNav` — the canonical
 * extraction pattern. DO NOT duplicate nav arrays between desktop and
 * mobile surfaces.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   1. Copy this file as `src/app/(app)/layout.tsx` (or equivalent).
 *   2. Copy `mobile-topbar.tsx.tmpl` as `src/components/mobile-topbar.tsx`.
 *   3. Refactor your existing sidebar to export `SidebarNav` (content)
 *      AND `Sidebar` (desktop aside wrapper).
 *   4. Import Footer if your surface has one.
 *
 * Contract:
 *   - `.app-shell` class comes from responsive-tokens.css.tmpl and
 *     reserves room for the mobile top-bar AND shifts right on desktop.
 *   - `suppressHydrationWarning` on wrappers covers Typekit / browser
 *     extensions mutating class attributes at hydration.
 */

import { MobileTopBar } from "@/components/mobile-topbar";
import { Sidebar } from "@/components/sidebar";
// import { SiteFooter } from "@/components/site-footer";

export default function AppLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div id="page-wrapper" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <div id="page" suppressHydrationWarning>
        <header id="header" aria-label="Site header">
          <MobileTopBar />
          <Sidebar />
        </header>
        <main id="main-content" className="app-shell">
          {children}
          {/* <SiteFooter /> */}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```


## Referência: references/squad/templates/responsive-tokens.css.tmpl

```text
/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Responsive Mobile-First Starter Tokens
   Source of truth: squads/design-ops/rules/responsive-first-contract.md
   Drop into globals.css at the top of :root. NEVER hand-edit the clamp
   functions without updating the contract first.

   These tokens are the mechanism that makes mobile-first "the default."
   Pages that consume them become responsive by construction — no
   `sm:/md:/lg:` breakpoint chains required.
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

:root {
  /* ── Layout chrome ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  --sidebar-width: 25rem;        /* desktop aside */
  --mobile-topbar-h: 6rem;       /* mobile top-bar height */

  /* ── Fluid vertical rhythm (sections, hero padding, divider gaps) ──
     Contract: mobile floor ≤ 50% of desktop ceiling.
     Never hardcode a rem value ≥4rem — use these tokens. */
  --section-py-xl: clamp(4rem, 9vw, 10rem);   /* dividers/heroes: 40→100 */
  --section-py-lg: clamp(3.2rem, 7vw, 8rem);  /* regular sections: 32→80 */
  --section-py-md: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 6rem);  /* compact: 24→60 */
  --section-py-sm: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 4rem);  /* dense: 16→40 */

  /* ── Fluid inter-element gaps ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  --gap-xl: clamp(2.4rem, 4vw, 6rem);
  --gap-lg: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 4rem);
  --gap-md: clamp(1.6rem, 2.5vw, 3rem);
  --gap-sm: clamp(1.2rem, 2vw, 2rem);

  /* ── Panel padding (cards, specimens, drawers) ────────────────────── */
  --panel-p:    clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 6rem);
  --panel-p-sm: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 3.2rem);
  --panel-p-lg: clamp(3.2rem, 6vw, 8rem);

  /* ── Container inline padding (viewport edges) ────────────────────── */
  --container-px: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 4rem);
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Horizontal-scroll guard — NON-NEGOTIABLE.
   `overflow-x: clip` prevents scroll without creating a scroll container
   (preserving sticky positioning). `max-width: 100vw` backstops stray
   elements. `min-width: 0` lets flex/grid children shrink below their
   content size so long words wrap instead of pushing the viewport. */
html, body {
  overflow-x: clip;
  max-width: 100vw;
}
*, *::before, *::after {
  min-width: 0;
}

/* Editorial display headings — wrap on overflow, never produce scroll. */
h1, h2, h3, .h1, .h2, .h3, [data-display-heading] {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  max-width: 100%;
  hyphens: manual;
}

/* Media scales to container; forbids intrinsic-width overflow. */
img, video, svg, canvas {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Fluid section utilities — replace `style={{ paddingBlock: "10rem" }}`
   patterns. Semantic names map 1:1 to the `--section-py-*` token family.
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.rp-section-xl { padding-block: var(--section-py-xl); }
.rp-section-lg { padding-block: var(--section-py-lg); }
.rp-section-md { padding-block: var(--section-py-md); }
.rp-section-sm { padding-block: var(--section-py-sm); }

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   App shell — reserves room for the mobile top-bar below and for the
   fixed sidebar on desktop. Pages stack inside `<main class="app-shell">`.
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.app-shell {
  padding-block-start: var(--mobile-topbar-h);
}

@media (min-width: 1080px) {
  .app-shell {
    margin-inline-start: var(--sidebar-width);
    padding-block-start: 0;
  }
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Touch targets — 44px minimum on mobile per WCAG 2.2 + iOS guidelines.
   Applies to anything carrying `data-touch-target`. Add the attribute
   to any custom interactive primitive not already derived from shadcn/ui.
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
[data-touch-target] {
  min-height: 4.4rem;
  min-width: 4.4rem;
}
```

# .state.yaml
# Design System State Tracking
# Brad writes audit/consolidation/tokenization data
# Merovingian reads and writes component building data
# Enables seamless handoff between agents

version: "1.0"
project_name: "{{project_name}}"
created_at: "{{created_timestamp}}"
updated_at: "{{updated_timestamp}}"
tailwind_version: "{{tailwind_version}}"

# Current phase in design system workflow
system_state:
  phase: "{{current_phase}}"  # audit_complete | consolidation_complete | tokenize_complete | migration_strategy_complete | setup_complete | building_components

  # Phase 1: Inventory (Brad)
  inventory:
    scanned_at: "{{scan_timestamp}}"
    scan_path: "{{scan_path}}"
    total_files: "{{total_files}}"
    frameworks_detected:
      react: "{{has_react}}"
      vue: "{{has_vue}}"
      html: "{{has_html}}"
    patterns:
      buttons:
        unique: "{{buttons_unique}}"
        instances: "{{buttons_instances}}"
        redundancy_factor: "{{buttons_redundancy}}"
      colors:
        unique: "{{colors_unique}}"
        instances: "{{colors_instances}}"
        redundancy_factor: "{{colors_redundancy}}"
      spacing:
        unique_padding: "{{spacing_padding}}"
        unique_margin: "{{spacing_margin}}"
      typography:
        unique_fonts: "{{typography_fonts}}"
        unique_sizes: "{{typography_sizes}}"
        unique_weights: "{{typography_weights}}"
      forms:
        unique_inputs: "{{forms_inputs}}"
        unique_forms: "{{forms_forms}}"
    estimated_monthly_cost: "{{estimated_cost}}"

  # Phase 2: Consolidation (Brad)
  consolidation:
    completed_at: "{{consolidation_timestamp}}"
    patterns_consolidated:
      colors:
        before: "{{colors_before}}"
        after: "{{colors_after}}"
        reduction: "{{colors_reduction}}%"
        clusters: "{{colors_clusters}}"
      buttons:
        before: "{{buttons_before}}"
        after: "{{buttons_after}}"
        reduction: "{{buttons_reduction}}%"
        variants: "{{buttons_variants}}"
      spacing:
        before: "{{spacing_before}}"
        after: "{{spacing_after}}"
        reduction: "{{spacing_reduction}}%"
        scale: "{{spacing_scale}}"
      typography:
        before: "{{typography_before}}"
        after: "{{typography_after}}"
        reduction: "{{typography_reduction}}%"
    overall_reduction: "{{overall_reduction}}%"
    target_met: "{{target_met}}"
    user_overrides: "{{user_overrides}}"

  # Phase 3: Tokenization (Brad)
  tokens:
    generated_at: "{{token_timestamp}}"
    version: "{{token_version}}"
    location: "{{token_location}}"
    exports:
      - tokens.yaml
      - tokens.json
      - tokens.css
      - tokens.tailwind.js
      - tokens.scss
      - tokens.dtcg.json
    categories:
      color: "{{token_color_count}}"
      spacing: "{{token_spacing_count}}"
      typography: "{{token_typography_count}}"
      radius: "{{token_radius_count}}"
      shadow: "{{token_shadow_count}}"
    total_tokens: "{{total_tokens}}"
    coverage: "{{token_coverage}}%"
    dtcg_compliant: "{{token_dtcg_compliant}}"
    color_space: "{{token_color_space}}"

  # Phase 4: ROI Analysis (Brad)
  roi:
    calculated_at: "{{roi_timestamp}}"
    before:
      patterns: "{{patterns_before}}"
      monthly_cost: "{{monthly_cost_before}}"
      annual_cost: "{{annual_cost_before}}"
    after:
      patterns: "{{patterns_after}}"
      monthly_cost: "{{monthly_cost_after}}"
      annual_cost: "{{annual_cost_after}}"
    savings:
      monthly: "{{monthly_savings}}"
      annual: "{{annual_savings}}"
    implementation:
      estimated_cost: "{{implementation_cost}}"
    roi_metrics:
      ratio: "{{roi_ratio}}"
      breakeven_months: "{{breakeven_months}}"

  # Phase 5: Migration Strategy (Brad)
  migration:
    strategy_created_at: "{{migration_timestamp}}"
    phases:
      - phase: 1
        name: "Foundation"
        duration_sprints: 1
        status: "{{phase1_status}}"
      - phase: 2
        name: "High-Impact"
        duration_sprints: 2-3
        priorities: "{{phase2_priorities}}"
        status: "{{phase2_status}}"
      - phase: 3
        name: "Long-Tail"
        duration_sprints: 2-4
        status: "{{phase3_status}}"
      - phase: 4
        name: "Enforcement"
        duration_sprints: 1
        status: "{{phase4_status}}"
    current_phase: "{{current_migration_phase}}"
    completion_percentage: "{{migration_completion}}"
    estimated_completion: "{{migration_completion_date}}"

  # Phase 6: Merovingian Setup
  atlas_setup:
    completed_at: "{{atlas_setup_timestamp}}"
    starting_point: "{{starting_point}}"  # brownfield | greenfield
    configuration:
      component_directory: "{{component_dir}}"
      css_approach: "{{css_approach}}"
      test_framework: "{{test_framework}}"
      storybook_enabled: "{{storybook_enabled}}"
    tokens_loaded: "{{tokens_loaded_success}}"

  # Phase 7: Component Building (Merovingian)
  patterns_built:
    atoms:
      total: "{{atoms_total}}"
      components: "{{atoms_list}}"
    molecules:
      total: "{{molecules_total}}"
      components: "{{molecules_list}}"
    organisms:
      total: "{{organisms_total}}"
      components: "{{organisms_list}}"
    templates:
      total: "{{templates_total}}"
      components: "{{templates_list}}"

  # Documentation (Merovingian)
  documentation:
    generated_at: "{{docs_timestamp}}"
    components_documented: "{{docs_components}}"
    pattern_library_location: "{{docs_location}}"

  # Integration (Merovingian)
  integrations:
    mmos:
      status: "{{mmos_integration_status}}"
      components: "{{mmos_components}}"
    creator_os:
      status: "{{creator_os_integration_status}}"
      components: "{{creator_os_components}}"
    innerlens:
      status: "{{innerlens_integration_status}}"
      components: "{{innerlens_components}}"

  tooling:
    tailwind:
      version: "{{tailwind_version}}"
      upgraded_at: "{{tailwind_upgraded_at}}"
      oxide_benchmark:
        full_build_ms: "{{tailwind_full_build_ms}}"
        incremental_build_us: "{{tailwind_incremental_build_us}}"
      theme_layers_validated: "{{tailwind_theme_validated}}"
    design_tokens:
      dtcg_version: "{{dtcg_version}}"
      exports:
        json: "{{dtcg_json_path}}"
        yaml: "{{dtcg_yaml_path}}"
      okclh_coverage: "{{oklch_coverage}}"
    shadcn:
      bootstrap_completed_at: "{{shadcn_bootstrap_timestamp}}"
      components_installed: "{{shadcn_components}}"
    dark_mode:
      enabled: "{{dark_mode_enabled}}"
      parity_score: "{{dark_mode_parity_score}}"

# Agent execution history (for debugging and handoff)
agent_history:
  - agent: "{{agent_name}}"
    command: "{{command}}"
    timestamp: "{{command_timestamp}}"
    args: "{{command_args}}"
    status: "{{command_status}}"

# Flags for agent communication
flags:
  ready_for_atlas: "{{ready_for_atlas}}"
  ready_for_migration: "{{ready_for_migration}}"
  system_complete: "{{system_complete}}"

```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-system-agentic-readiness
  name: Design System Agentic Readiness
  description: Audit and setup machine-readable artifacts so AI agents can safely consume the design system.
  version: 1.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-agentic-audit
      id: step-1-agentic-audit
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Audit Agentic Readiness
      agent: brad-frost
      action: agentic-audit
      outputs:
        - report
      next: step-2-agentic-setup
    - step: step-2-agentic-setup
      id: step-2-agentic-setup
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Setup Agentic Foundations
      agent: brad-frost
      action: agentic-setup
      outputs:
        - setup_report
        - metadata_file
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
metadata:
  author: Brad (Design System Architect)
  created_date: "2026-02-17"
  last_modified: "2026-02-17"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - agentic
    - metadata
    - governance
inputs:
  codebase_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to evaluate for agentic readiness
    required: true
  project_name:
    type: string
    description: Project namespace for outputs
    required: true
    default: my-app
steps:
  - id: step_1_agentic_audit
    name: Audit Agentic Readiness
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*agentic-audit"
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
    outputs:
      report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/agentic/agentic-audit.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_agentic_setup
    name: Setup Agentic Foundations
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*agentic-setup"
    inputs:
      audit_report: "{{step_1_agentic_audit.report}}"
    outputs:
      setup_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/agentic/agentic-setup.md
      metadata_file: workspace/domains/design-system/metadata/components.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
outputs:
  readiness_complete:
    type: boolean
    source: step_2_agentic_setup.success
  readiness_report:
    type: string
    source: step_2_agentic_setup.setup_report
quality_gates:
  internal_quality_chain:
    required:
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/generate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/sync_design_manifest.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_design_manifest_drift.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_task_checklist_bindings.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_mcp_skeleton.cjs
    optional:
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/test_mcp_tools.cjs
    blocking: true
    policy: internal-first
    exception:
      external_tool_allowed_with:
        - capability_gap_documented
        - rationale_recorded
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/audit-only.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-system-audit-only
  name: Design System Audit-Only
  description: |
    Audit-only workflow: scan codebase for UI chaos, generate visual shock report
    and ROI calculation for stakeholder presentation.

    Atomic-layer audit (per ADR-052 — ACCEPTED-WITH-CONDITIONS): the audit MUST detect
    classification anti-patterns and flag them as findings:
      - shell-as-organism (full app shells classified as organism → should be PAGE/LAYOUT)
      - page-as-organism (full screens classified as organism → should be PAGE)
      - button-as-molecule (atomic primitives classified as molecule → should be ATOM)
      - template-with-real-content (layouts containing realistic data → should be PAGE)
    Anti-patterns count adds to the shock report severity.

    Mandatory governance protocol: squads/design-system/protocols/ai-first-governance.md
  version: 2.1.0
  adr_ref: ADR-052
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-audit
      id: step-1-audit
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Audit Codebase for Pattern Redundancy
      agent: brad-frost
      action: audit
      outputs:
        - inventory_report
        - state_file
      next: step-2-consolidate
    - step: step-2-consolidate
      id: step-2-consolidate
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Consolidate Patterns for Metrics
      agent: brad-frost
      action: consolidate
      outputs:
        - consolidation_report
        - reduction_metrics
      next: step-3-shock-report
    - step: step-3-shock-report
      id: step-3-shock-report
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Generate Visual Shock Report
      agent: brad-frost
      action: shock-report
      outputs:
        - shock_report_html
        - shock_report_pdf
        - screenshots
      next: step-4-calculate-roi
    - step: step-4-calculate-roi
      id: step-4-calculate-roi
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Calculate ROI and Cost Savings
      agent: brad-frost
      action: calculate-roi
      outputs:
        - roi_report
        - roi_summary
        - executive_summary
      next: step-5-tokenize-preview
    - step: step-5-tokenize-preview
      id: step-5-tokenize-preview
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Preview Token Recommendations (Optional)
      agent: brad-frost
      action: tokenize
      outputs:
        - token_preview
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
metadata:
  author: Brad (Design System Architect)
  created_date: "2025-10-27"
  last_modified: "2026-02-16"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - audit
    - shock-report
    - roi
    - executive
    - brad
inputs:
  codebase_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to codebase for audit (e.g., ./src)
    required: true
    validation: Must be valid directory path
  project_name:
    type: string
    description: Project name for output organization
    required: true
    default: my-app
  hourly_rate:
    type: number
    description: Developer hourly rate for ROI calculation (USD)
    required: false
    default: 150
  team_size:
    type: number
    description: Number of developers on team
    required: false
    default: 5
steps:
  - id: step_1_audit
    name: Audit Codebase for Pattern Redundancy
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*audit"
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
    outputs:
      inventory_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/audit/inventory.yaml
      state_file: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/.state.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_consolidate
    name: Consolidate Patterns for Metrics
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*consolidate"
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_audit.inventory_report}}"
    outputs:
      consolidation_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/consolidation/decisions.yaml
      reduction_metrics: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/consolidation/metrics.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_3_shock_report
    name: Generate Visual Shock Report
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*shock-report"
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_audit.inventory_report}}"
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
    outputs:
      shock_report_html: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/shock-report.html
      shock_report_pdf: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/shock-report.pdf
      screenshots: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/screenshots/
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_4_calculate_roi
    name: Calculate ROI and Cost Savings
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*calculate-roi"
    inputs:
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
      reduction_metrics: "{{step_2_consolidate.reduction_metrics}}"
      hourly_rate: "{{hourly_rate}}"
      team_size: "{{team_size}}"
    outputs:
      roi_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/roi.yaml
      roi_summary: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/roi-summary.md
      executive_summary: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/executive-summary.pdf
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_5_tokenize_preview
    name: Preview Token Recommendations (Optional)
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*tokenize"
    inputs:
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
      preview_mode: true
    outputs:
      token_preview: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/token-preview.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
outputs:
  audit_complete:
    type: boolean
    description: Audit completed successfully
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.success
  shock_report_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to visual shock report (HTML)
    source: step_3_shock_report.shock_report_html
  roi_summary_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to ROI summary (Markdown)
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.roi_summary
  executive_summary_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to executive summary (PDF)
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.executive_summary
  pattern_count_before:
    type: number
    description: Total patterns before consolidation
    source: step_2_consolidate.reduction_metrics.before
  pattern_count_after:
    type: number
    description: Recommended patterns after consolidation
    source: step_2_consolidate.reduction_metrics.after
  reduction_percentage:
    type: number
    description: Pattern reduction percentage
    source: step_2_consolidate.reduction_metrics.reduction_percent
  annual_savings_usd:
    type: number
    description: Projected annual cost savings (USD)
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.roi_report.annual_savings
  roi_ratio:
    type: number
    description: ROI ratio (savings/investment)
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.roi_report.roi_ratio
  breakeven_days:
    type: number
    description: Days to breakeven
    source: step_4_calculate_roi.roi_report.breakeven_days
global_error_handling:
  on_error: abort
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console
security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
quality_gates:
  internal_quality_chain:
    required:
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/generate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/sync_design_manifest.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_design_manifest_drift.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_task_checklist_bindings.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_mcp_skeleton.cjs
    optional:
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/test_mcp_tools.cjs
    blocking: true
    policy: internal-first
    exception:
      external_tool_allowed_with:
        - capability_gap_documented
        - rationale_recorded
```
