```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-system-brownfield-complete
  name: Design System Brownfield Complete
  description: "Complete workflow for brownfield projects: audit UI chaos, consolidate patterns, extract tokens, plan migration, then build production components. Mandatory governance protocol: squads/design-system/protocols/ai-first-governance.md"
  version: 2.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-audit
      id: step-1-audit
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Audit Codebase for Pattern Redundancy
      agent: brad-frost
      action: audit
      outputs:
        - inventory_report
        - state_file
      next: step-2-consolidate
    - step: step-2-consolidate
      id: step-2-consolidate
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Consolidate Patterns Using Clustering
      agent: brad-frost
      action: consolidate
      outputs:
        - consolidation_report
        - reduction_metrics
      next: step-3-tokenize
    - step: step-3-tokenize
      id: step-3-tokenize
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Extract Design Tokens
      agent: brad-frost
      action: tokenize
      outputs:
        - tokens_yaml
        - tokens_json
        - tokens_css
        - tokens_tailwind
      next: step-4-migrate
    - step: step-4-migrate
      id: step-4-migrate
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Generate Migration Strategy
      agent: brad-frost
      action: migrate
      outputs:
        - migration_plan
      next: step-5-shock-report
    - step: step-5-shock-report
      id: step-5-shock-report
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Generate Shock Report (Optional)
      agent: brad-frost
      action: shock-report
      outputs:
        - shock_report
      next: step-6-calculate-roi
    - step: step-6-calculate-roi
      id: step-6-calculate-roi
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Calculate ROI (Optional)
      agent: brad-frost
      action: calculate-roi
      outputs:
        - roi_report
      next: step-7-build-atoms
    - step: step-7-build-atoms
      id: step-7-build-atoms
      phase: 7
      phase_name: Build Atomic Components
      agent: brad-frost
      action: build
      outputs:
        - components
      next: step-8-compose-molecules
    - step: step-8-compose-molecules
      id: step-8-compose-molecules
      phase: 8
      phase_name: Compose Molecule Components
      agent: brad-frost
      action: compose
      outputs:
        - molecules
      next: step-9-document
    - step: step-9-document
      id: step-9-document
      phase: 9
      phase_name: Generate Pattern Library Documentation
      agent: brad-frost
      action: document
      outputs:
        - documentation
        - storybook
      next: step-9b-motion-quality
    - step: step-9b-motion-quality
      id: step-9b-motion-quality
      phase: 9.5
      phase_name: Apply Kinetic Motion Layer (Optional)
      agent: brad-frost
      action: workflow
      workflow: motion-quality
      optional: true
      condition: "brand_personality is set OR reference_url is set"
      outputs:
        - motion_tokens
        - motion_primitives
        - motion_map
      next: step-10-promote-to-workspace
    - step: step-10-promote-to-workspace
      id: step-10-promote-to-workspace
      phase: 10
      phase_name: Promote Outputs to Workspace Canonical Locations
      agent: brad-frost
      action: sync-registry
      outputs:
        - tokens_promoted
        - registry_updated
        - metadata_updated
      next: step-11-critical-eye
    - step: step-11-critical-eye
      id: step-11-critical-eye
      phase: 11
      phase_name: Run Critical Eye Curation Cycle
      agent: brad-frost
      action: workflow
      outputs:
        - catalog_updated
        - cycle_report
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
metadata:
  author: Brad (Design System Architect)
  created_date: "2025-10-27"
  last_modified: "2026-03-23"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - brownfield
    - audit
    - consolidation
    - components
    - brad
inputs:
  codebase_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to codebase for audit (e.g., ./src)
    required: true
    validation: Must be valid directory path
  project_name:
    type: string
    description: Project name for output organization
    required: true
    default: my-app
  reference_url:
    type: string
    description: URL to extract animations from (for motion-quality sub-workflow Phase 4)
    required: false
  brand_personality:
    type: string
    description: "Motion personality: playful | professional | minimal | dramatic (for motion-quality sub-workflow)"
    required: false
    default: professional
steps:
  - id: step_1_audit
    name: Audit Codebase for Pattern Redundancy
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*audit"
    inputs:
      path: "{{codebase_path}}"
    outputs:
      inventory_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/audit/inventory.yaml
      state_file: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/.state.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_consolidate
    name: Consolidate Patterns Using Clustering
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*consolidate"
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_audit.inventory_report}}"
    outputs:
      consolidation_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/consolidation/decisions.yaml
      reduction_metrics: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/consolidation/metrics.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_3_tokenize
    name: Extract Design Tokens
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*tokenize"
    inputs:
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
    outputs:
      tokens_yaml: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.yaml
      tokens_json: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.json
      tokens_css: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.css
      tokens_tailwind: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.tailwind.js
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_4_migrate
    name: Generate Migration Strategy
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*migrate"
    inputs:
      tokens: "{{step_3_tokenize.tokens_yaml}}"
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"

      migration_plan: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/migration/plan.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_5_shock_report
    name: Generate Shock Report (Optional)
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*shock-report"
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_audit.inventory_report}}"
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
    outputs:
      shock_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/shock-report.html
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_6_calculate_roi
    name: Calculate ROI (Optional)
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*calculate-roi"
    inputs:
      consolidation: "{{step_2_consolidate.consolidation_report}}"
    outputs:
      roi_report: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/reports/roi.yaml
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_7_build_atoms
    name: Build Atomic Components
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*build"
    inputs:
      tokens: "{{step_3_tokenize.tokens_yaml}}"
      patterns: button,input,label,icon
    outputs:
      components: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/atoms/
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_8_compose_molecules
    name: Compose Molecule Components
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*compose"
    inputs:
      atoms: "{{step_7_build_atoms.components}}"
      patterns: form-field,card,alert
    outputs:
      molecules: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/molecules/
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_9_document
    name: Generate Pattern Library Documentation
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*document"
    inputs:
      components: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
      tokens: "{{step_3_tokenize.tokens_yaml}}"
    outputs:
      documentation: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/docs/
      storybook: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/.storybook/
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_9b_motion_quality
    name: Apply Kinetic Motion Layer (Optional)
    type: workflow
    agent: brad-frost
    workflow: motion-quality
    description: >
      Invoke the motion-quality sub-workflow to apply the Kinetic Design System
      motion layer. Runs only when brand_personality or reference_url are provided.
      Non-blocking: motion failure does not halt the brownfield pipeline.
    optional: true
    condition: "{{brand_personality}} is set OR {{reference_url}} is set"
    inputs:
      codebase_path: "{{codebase_path}}"
      project_name: "{{project_name}}"
      reference_url: "{{reference_url}}"
      brand_personality: "{{brand_personality}}"
    outputs:
      motion_tokens: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-tokens.css
      motion_primitives: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-primitives.css
      motion_map: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/motion/motion-map.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
  - id: step_10_promote_to_workspace
    name: Promote Outputs to Workspace Canonical Locations
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    command: "*sync-registry"
    description: Move outputs from outputs/ to workspace canonical paths
    inputs:
      tokens_source: "{{step_3_tokenize.tokens_yaml}}"
      components_source: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
    outputs:
      tokens_promoted: workspace/system/tokens/
      registry_updated: workspace/ui/registry.json
      metadata_updated: workspace/domains/design-system/metadata/components.json
    promotion_map:
      - from: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.json
        to: workspace/system/tokens/primitive.tokens.json
      - from: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/tokens/tokens.yaml
        to: squads/design-system/data/design-tokens-spec.yaml
      - from: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
        to: workspace/ui/components/
    validation:
      - workspace/ui/registry.json updated with new components
      - workspace/domains/design-system/metadata/components.json reflects changes
      - squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs passes
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_11_critical_eye
    name: Run Critical Eye Curation Cycle
    type: workflow
    agent: brad-frost
    workflow: critical-eye
    description: Evaluate all promoted patterns through the Critical Eye scoring engine. Scores variants (0-100), applies lifecycle transitions, generates proposals for canonical promotion. Non-blocking — brownfield completes even if curation is skipped.
    inputs:
      catalog: workspace/ui/pattern-catalog.json
      scoring_rules: squads/design-system/data/critical-eye-scoring-rules.yaml
      decisions_log: workspace/ui/canonical-decisions.json
    outputs:
      catalog_updated: workspace/ui/pattern-catalog.json
      cycle_report: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/report.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
outputs:
  design_system_complete:
    type: boolean
    description: Workflow completed successfully
    source: step_10_promote_to_workspace.success
  tokens_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to design tokens
    source: step_3_tokenize.tokens_yaml
  components_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to generated components
    source: outputs/design-system/{{project_name}}/components/
  migration_plan_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to migration plan
    source: step_4_migrate.migration_plan
  shock_report_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to shock report (if generated)
    source: step_5_shock_report.shock_report
  roi_metrics:
    type: string
    description: ROI calculation results
    source: step_6_calculate_roi.roi_report
global_error_handling:
  on_error: abort
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console
security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
quality_gates:
  internal_quality_chain:
    required:
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/generate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_components_metadata.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/sync_design_manifest.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_design_manifest_drift.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_task_checklist_bindings.cjs
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/validate_mcp_skeleton.cjs
    optional:
      - node squads/design-system/scripts/design-system/test_mcp_tools.cjs
    blocking: true
    policy: internal-first
    exception:
      external_tool_allowed_with:
        - capability_gap_documented
        - rationale_recorded
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/critical-eye.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-system-critical-eye
  name: Critical Eye — Continuous DS Curation
  description: "Recurring workflow that evaluates all pattern variants across categories, scores them (0-100), and promotes/demotes through lifecycle states (CANDIDATE → EXPERIMENTAL → STABLE → CANONICAL → DEPRECATED). Runs after each extraction cycle. Mandatory governance protocol: squads/design-system/protocols/ai-first-governance.md"
  version: 1.0.0
  type: sequential
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-inventory
      id: step-1-inventory
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Inventory All Variants Per Category
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-critical-eye-inventory
      outputs:
        - inventory
      next: step-2-score
    - step: step-2-score
      id: step-2-score
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Score Each Variant Using 5 Dimensions
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-critical-eye-score
      outputs:
        - scored_variants
      next: step-3-compare
    - step: step-3-compare
      id: step-3-compare
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Compare and Rank Variants Within Category
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-critical-eye-compare
      outputs:
        - rankings
      next: step-4-decide
    - step: step-4-decide
      id: step-4-decide
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Make Lifecycle Transition Decisions
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-critical-eye-decide
      outputs:
        - decisions
        - proposals
        - updated_catalog
        - updated_decisions_log
      next: step-5-review
    - step: step-5-review
      id: step-5-review
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Human Review for Canonical Promotions
      agent: design-chief
      action: ds-critical-eye-review-checklist
      outputs:
        - review_decisions
      next: step-6-report
    - step: step-6-report
      id: step-6-report
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Generate Cycle Report
      agent: brad-frost
      action: ds-critical-eye-report
      outputs:
        - report
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete
  handoff_prompts:
    brad-frost_to_design-chief: Handoff context from brad-frost to design-chief. Preserve outputs, risks, and open decisions.
    design-chief_to_brad-frost: Handoff context from design-chief to brad-frost. Preserve outputs, risks, and open decisions.
metadata:
  author: Brad Frost (Design System Architect)
  created_date: "2026-02-18"
  last_modified: "2026-02-18"
  tags:
    - design-system
    - curation
    - critical-eye
    - scoring
    - lifecycle
    - governance
    - brad
inputs:
  catalog_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to the pattern catalog JSON
    required: true
    default: workspace/ui/pattern-catalog.json
  scoring_rules_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to the scoring rules YAML
    required: true
    default: squads/design-system/data/critical-eye-scoring-rules.yaml
  decisions_log_path:
    type: string
    description: Path to the append-only decisions log
    required: true
    default: workspace/ui/canonical-decisions.json
  cycle_number:
    type: integer
    description: Current evaluation cycle (auto-incremented from catalog.evaluationCycle)
    required: false
  categories_filter:
    type: array
    description: "Optional: evaluate only specific categories (empty = all)"
    required: false
    default: []
steps:
  - id: step_1_inventory
    name: Inventory All Variants Per Category
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    task: ds-critical-eye-inventory
    description: Scan pattern-catalog.json and group all variants by category. Detect new variants from latest extraction. Cross-reference with registry.json and metadata.
    inputs:
      catalog: "{{catalog_path}}"
      categories_filter: "{{categories_filter}}"
    outputs:
      inventory: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/inventory.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_2_score
    name: Score Each Variant Using 5 Dimensions
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    task: ds-critical-eye-score
    description: Apply scoring engine (breadth 25 + quality 30 + consistency 20 + maturity 15 + simplicity 10 = 100) to every variant. Check a11y blocker (score=0 → auto-REJECT).
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_inventory.inventory}}"
      scoring_rules: "{{scoring_rules_path}}"
    outputs:
      scored_variants: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/scored.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_3_compare
    name: Compare and Rank Variants Within Category
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    task: ds-critical-eye-compare
    description: Within each category, rank variants by total score. Apply tiebreaker rule (breadth wins within 10% margin). Identify top candidate per category.
    inputs:
      scored_variants: "{{step_2_score.scored_variants}}"
      scoring_rules: "{{scoring_rules_path}}"
    outputs:
      rankings: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/rankings.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_4_decide
    name: Make Lifecycle Transition Decisions
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    task: ds-critical-eye-decide
    description: Apply lifecycle transition rules. Auto-transitions (CANDIDATE→EXPERIMENTAL, EXPERIMENTAL→STABLE) execute immediately. Checkpoint transitions (STABLE→CANONICAL, CANONICAL→DEPRECATED) generate proposals for design-chief review.
    inputs:
      rankings: "{{step_3_compare.rankings}}"
      catalog: "{{catalog_path}}"
      decisions_log: "{{decisions_log_path}}"
    outputs:
      decisions: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/decisions.json
      proposals: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/proposals.json
      updated_catalog: "{{catalog_path}}"
      updated_decisions_log: "{{decisions_log_path}}"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
  - id: step_5_review
    name: Human Review for Canonical Promotions
    type: checkpoint
    agent: design-chief
    task: ds-critical-eye-review-checklist
    description: Design Chief reviews proposals for STABLE→CANONICAL and CANONICAL→DEPRECATED transitions. Uses review checklist. Required only when proposals exist.
    condition: "{{step_4_decide.proposals}} is not empty"
    inputs:
      proposals: "{{step_4_decide.proposals}}"
      rankings: "{{step_3_compare.rankings}}"
    outputs:
      review_decisions: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/review-decisions.json
    error_handling:
      strategy: wait
  - id: step_6_report
    name: Generate Cycle Report
    type: agent
    agent: brad-frost
    task: ds-critical-eye-report
    description: "Compile comprehensive cycle report: summary stats, all scores, transitions executed, proposals pending, category health."
    inputs:
      inventory: "{{step_1_inventory.inventory}}"
      scored_variants: "{{step_2_score.scored_variants}}"
      rankings: "{{step_3_compare.rankings}}"
      decisions: "{{step_4_decide.decisions}}"
      review_decisions: "{{step_5_review.review_decisions}}"
      cycle_number: "{{cycle_number}}"
    outputs:
      report: outputs/design-system/critical-eye/cycle-{{cycle_number}}/report.md
    error_handling:
      strategy: skip
outputs:
  cycle_complete:
    type: boolean
    description: Critical Eye cycle completed successfully
    source: step_6_report.success
  catalog_updated:
    type: string
    description: Updated pattern catalog with new scores and lifecycle states
    source: "{{catalog_path}}"
  decisions_logged:
    type: string
    description: Append-only decisions log with new entries
    source: "{{decisions_log_path}}"
  report_location:
    type: string
    description: Path to the cycle report
    source: step_6_report.report
  pending_proposals:
    type: integer
    description: Number of proposals awaiting human review
    source: step_4_decide.proposals.length
global_error_handling:
  on_error: abort
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      - console
security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true
```


## Referência: references/squad/workflows/ds-static-to-dynamic-migration.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: design-ops-ds-static-to-dynamic-migration
  name: DS Static-to-Dynamic Migration (framework-agnostic)
  version: 2.1.0
  description: >-
    Migrates a static design system (HTML + CSS tokens + UI kits) into an app on
    Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui + TypeScript strict, on the chosen framework (next|vite).
    Based on archetype `squads/design-ops/data/ds-archetype.yaml` v2.0.0 separating
    INVARIANT (Tailwind+shadcn+Radix+TS+tokens+24 primitives) from PARAMETERIZED
    (framework+profile) and BRAND-DRIVEN (icons, animations, brand colors, typography)
    and EMERGENT (specialized primitives + discovered surfaces). Produces non-identical
    outcomes between brands while preserving the common backbone, now also across frameworks.
  type: sequential-with-branches
  archetype_ref: squads/design-ops/data/ds-archetype.yaml
  sinkra_process_ref: outputs/sinkra-squad/migracao-ds-estatico-para-dinamico-tokenizado/sinkra-output.yaml
  reference_implementations:
    lean: apps/redpine-ds
    full: apps/aiox-brandbook
    executed: apps/anthropic-ds
  profiles:
    lean:
      description: "Next + Tailwind v4 + shadcn sem Storybook, mirror redpine-ds"
      visual_gate: manual_checklist
      deps_extra: []
    full:
      description: "Lean + Storybook + DTCG tokens sync + Playwright visual regression"
      visual_gate: playwright_regression
      deps_extra: [storybook, "@storybook/nextjs-vite", "@chromatic-com/storybook", "@playwright/test"]

  sequence:
    - step: org-brand-discovery
      phase: 0
      phase_name: "Organism 0 — Brand Discovery (scan source, produce brand-profile)"
      agent: design-chief
      action: discover
      outputs: [brand_profile, declared_primitives_baseline_map, proposed_specialized_primitives, discovered_surfaces]
      gate: G0
      next: org-scaffold

    - step: org-scaffold
      phase: 1
      phase_name: "Organism 1 — Scaffold Next/TS/Tailwind/shadcn (INVARIANT)"
      agent: design-chief
      action: scaffold
      outputs: [legacy_moved, configs_written, src_skeleton, deps_installed]
      gate: G1
      next: org-token-system

    - step: org-token-system
      phase: 2
      phase_name: "Organism 2 — Token System (PARAMETERIZED via brand-profile)"
      agent: design-chief
      action: wire-tokens
      outputs: [globals_css_complete, type_scale_wired, dark_mode_ready]
      gate: G2
      next: org-primitive-layer

    - step: org-primitive-layer
      phase: 3
      phase_name: "Organism 3 — Primitive Layer (INVARIANT baseline + EMERGENT approved)"
      agent: design-chief
      action: build-primitives
      outputs: [ui_primitives_baseline, ui_primitives_specialized, composition_components]
      gate: G3
      next: [org-route-system-preview, org-route-system-kits]
      parallel_group: route-system-parallel

    - step: org-route-system-preview
      phase: 4a
      phase_name: "Organism 4 — Preview Routes (parallel with kits)"
      agent: design-chief
      action: build-preview-routes
      outputs: [preview_routes, preview_layout, theme_toggle]
      parallel: true
      parallel_join_at: G4
      next: org-qa-gates

    - step: org-route-system-kits
      phase: 4b
      phase_name: "Organism 4 — Kit Routes (EMERGENT surfaces from discovery)"
      agent: design-chief
      action: build-kit-routes
      outputs: [kit_routes, kit_composition]
      parallel: true
      parallel_join_at: G4
      next: org-qa-gates

    - step: org-qa-gates
      phase: 5
      phase_name: "Organism 5 — QA Gates (INVARIANT quality contract)"
      agent: design-chief
      action: run-qa
      outputs: [tsc_pass, build_pass, lint_pass, visual_gate_verdict]
      gate: G5
      next: org-fix-polish

    - step: org-fix-polish
      phase: 6
      phase_name: "Organism 6 — Fix & Polish (next-themes, registered icon library, dead code strip)"
      agent: design-chief
      action: finalize
      outputs: [themes_persistent, icons_consolidated, dead_aliases_stripped, docs_updated]
      gate: G6
      next: workflow-end

    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete

inputs:
  target_app_name:
    type: string
    description: "Nome do app target em apps/ (e.g., foo-ds)"
    required: true
  source_static_dir:
    type: string
    description: "Diretório com HTML + CSS estáticos a migrar (relativo a target app)"
    required: true
    default: legacy-static
  framework:
    type: string
    description: "Target framework — next (Next.js 16) | vite (Vite 5). Other frameworks (astro, remix, sveltekit) are ARCHITECTURAL_PLACEHOLDER in archetype v2.0.0."
    required: true
    default: next
    validation: "Must be: next or vite (MVP)"
    archetype_ref: "squads/design-ops/data/ds-archetype.yaml#parameterized.framework.shape"
  profile:
    type: string
    description: "lean (redpine-like) | full (aiox-brandbook-like — unlocks mandatory_outputs.full_only)"
    required: true
    default: lean
    validation: "Must be: lean or full"
  reference_brand:
    type: string
    description: "Brand owner name (metadata, aria-labels, legal footer)"
    required: true
  tokens_source_css:
    type: string
    description: "Path ao arquivo CSS fonte de tokens (relativo a legacy-static/)"
    required: false
    default: colors_and_type.css
  interaction_mode:
    type: string
    description: "interactive (user aprova emergent primitives) | yolo (aceita tudo com evidence_score >= 0.7)"
    required: false
    default: interactive
  workflow_mode:
    type: string
    description: "migration (default — static DS → Next/Tailwind/shadcn) | extension (add to existing DS — DEFERRED; see rules/extension-vocabulary-match.md)"
    required: false
    default: migration
    deferred_modes:
      extension:
        status: DEFERRED
        rule: squads/design-ops/rules/extension-vocabulary-match.md
        expected_workflow: squads/design-ops/workflows/ds-extension.yaml (not yet authored)
        invocation: "For now, @design-chief enforces extension-vocabulary-match.md protocol interactively. Build the workflow when demand materializes."

steps:

  # ── ORGANISM 0 — Brand Discovery (Worker: deterministic node script) ─
  - id: step-0-brand-discovery
    name: "Scan source DS and produce brand-profile (Worker-class)"
    type: script
    script: squads/design-ops/scripts/design-system/discover-brand.cjs
    command: "node squads/design-ops/scripts/design-system/discover-brand.cjs --source=apps/{{target_app_name}}/{{source_static_dir}} --output=outputs/design-ops/{{target_app_name}}/brand-profile.yaml"
    inputs:
      source_dir: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/{{source_static_dir}}"
      archetype: "squads/design-ops/data/ds-archetype.yaml"
    deterministic: true
    idempotent: true
    fallback_to_agent: design-chief
    fallback_trigger: "Worker fails OR brand-profile.yaml coverage gaps require human judgment (e.g., colors unclassifiable)"
    sub_actions:
      - "Worker: extract colors (HSL-raw + hsl-fn + hex) — classify into foundation/text/border/brand_accent/feedback/unclassified"
      - "Worker: parse @import URLs + --font-* families; identify primary_by_tier {sans, display, serif, mono}"
      - "Worker: match legacy-static/preview/components-*.html against invariant.baseline_primitives (24) — status per primitive: matched_dedicated_preview | mentioned_in_html | missing_from_source"
      - "Worker: detect specialized via archetype.emergent.discovery.primitives.specialized_detection.catalog — score evidence 0–1 (prose signal + structural class/id match; class-only = 0.6, both = 1.0)"
      - "Worker: list legacy-static/ui_kits/*/ subdirs; infer category via CATEGORY_SIGNALS (product|marketing|docs|pitch-deck|ops|unknown)"
      - "Worker: scan assets/ for logos and preview/type-* for typography specimens"
      - "Worker: emit brand-profile.yaml"
    outputs:
      brand_profile: "outputs/design-ops/{{target_app_name}}/brand-profile.yaml"
      declared_primitives_baseline_map: "outputs/design-ops/{{target_app_name}}/baseline-coverage.yaml"
      proposed_specialized_primitives: "outputs/design-ops/{{target_app_name}}/proposed-specialized.yaml"
      discovered_surfaces: "outputs/design-ops/{{target_app_name}}/discovered-surfaces.yaml"
    approval:
      trigger: "proposed_specialized_primitives has entries"
      mode: "{{interaction_mode}}"
      behavior:
        interactive: "Present proposed list to user; user approves subset; rejected items archived with rationale"
        yolo: "Auto-approve entries with evidence_score >= 0.7"
    validation:
      - "brand-profile.yaml parses as valid YAML"
      - "colors section covers all parameterized.brand_colors.shape required roles"
      - "typography section has display/body/mono tiers"
      - "discovered_surfaces >= 0 (may be empty — some DSs have no kits)"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
      fallback: "agent-inline — request user to declare brand-profile.yaml manually"

  # ── ORGANISM 1 — Scaffold ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  - id: step-1-scaffold
    name: Scaffold framework + Tailwind + shadcn (archetype INVARIANT + framework shape)
    type: script
    script: squads/design-ops/scripts/design-system/scaffold-ds.sh
    command: "scaffold-ds.sh --target={{target_app_name}} --framework={{framework}} --profile={{profile}} --source-dir={{source_static_dir}}"
    inputs:
      target: "{{target_app_name}}"
      framework: "{{framework}}"
      profile: "{{profile}}"
    emits:
      baseline:
        - "scripts/check-token-drift.mjs (from template)"
        - "src/design-system/components.map.json (skeleton with status field)"
        - "focus-indicators-global injected into globals.css (WCAG 2.2 AAA)"
      full_only:
        - "scripts/build-manifest.mjs (from template)"
        - "src/design-system/exports/tokens.dtcg.json (skeleton)"
        - "package.json enriched: designTokensLanguageServer + build:manifest + build:tokens + Storybook"
    outputs:
      legacy_moved: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/legacy-static/"
      configs_written: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/{package.json,tsconfig.json,next.config.ts,postcss.config.mjs,eslint.config.mjs,components.json}"
      src_skeleton: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/src/"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail
      fallback: agent-inline

  # ── ORGANISM 2 — Token System ─────────────────────────────────────────
  - id: step-2-tokens
    name: Port tokens to globals.css with @theme inline (per archetype 4-tier architecture)
    type: agent
    agent: design-chief
    command: "*wire-tokens"
    inputs:
      source_css: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/legacy-static/{{tokens_source_css}}"
      target_css: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/src/app/globals.css"
      brand_profile: "{{step-0-brand-discovery.brand_profile}}"
    sub_actions:
      - "Port raw HSL tokens from source CSS into :root (tier 1)"
      - "Create semantic aliases per archetype tier 2 (--bg/--fg-*/--ds-accent/--success/etc)"
      - "Map shadcn slots per archetype tier 3 (--background/--foreground/--primary/--card/etc)"
      - "Wire @theme inline per archetype tier 4 (text scale + leading + tracking + colors + radii)"
      - "Declare @custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))"
      - "Preserve dark-mode HSL overrides from source (both `.dark` and `[data-theme=\"dark\"]`)"
    outputs:
      globals_css_complete: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/src/app/globals.css"
    validation:
      - "globals.css contains @theme inline block"
      - "--color-*, --text-*, --leading-*, --tracking-* wired"
      - "@custom-variant dark declared"
      - "HSL raw tokens + semantic + shadcn slots all 3 tiers present"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail

  # ── ORGANISM 3 — Primitive Layer ──────────────────────────────────────
  - id: step-3-primitives
    name: "Build primitives (INVARIANT baseline + EMERGENT approved)"
    type: agent
    agent: design-chief
    command: "*build-primitives"
    inputs:
      tokens_globals: "{{step-2-tokens.globals_css_complete}}"
      reference_lean: "apps/redpine-ds/src/components/ui"
      reference_full: "apps/aiox-brandbook/src/components/ui"
      brand: "{{reference_brand}}"
      brand_profile: "{{step-0-brand-discovery.brand_profile}}"
      baseline_coverage: "{{step-0-brand-discovery.declared_primitives_baseline_map}}"
      approved_specialized: "{{step-0-brand-discovery.proposed_specialized_primitives}}"
    sub_actions:
      baseline_phase:
        - "ALWAYS generate all 24 archetype.invariant.baseline_primitives in src/components/ui/"
        - "Use redpine-ds as API template; adapt color utilities to brand tokens"
        - "Every primitive: cva + data-slot + asChild via radix-ui Slot + React.ComponentProps<> typing + cn()"
      specialized_phase:
        - "FOR EACH approved specialized primitive from discovery:"
        - "  - Look up reference implementation (redpine/aiox/anthropic per archetype.emergent.discovery.primitives.specialized_detection.catalog evidence)"
        - "  - Adapt to brand tokens + target primitive vocabulary (cva variants derived from source HTML)"
        - "  - Place in src/components/ui/ (single-responsibility) OR src/components/{category}/ (composition)"
      composition_phase:
        - "Generate src/components/logo.tsx — variants per logo SVGs discovered in assets/"
        - "Generate src/components/typography.tsx — Display/H1-H4/Body/BodyLg/Eyebrow/Prose/Code using @theme inline tokens"
        - "Generate src/components/nav/{top-bar,sidebar}.tsx — scaffolded if source kits have nav patterns"
    outputs:
      ui_primitives_baseline: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/src/components/ui/ (24 files)"
      ui_primitives_specialized: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/src/components/ui/ (N approved) OR src/components/{category}/"
      composition_components: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/src/components/{logo,typography,nav}/"
    target_count:
      baseline: 24
      specialized: "N (approved at discovery)"
      composition: "3 base + M (derived from surfaces)"
    validation:
      - "tsc --noEmit passes"
      - "All baseline 24 present"
      - "All approved specialized present (no more, no less)"
      - "All primitives follow archetype.invariant.baseline_primitives.contract"
      - "No direct @radix-ui/* imports"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail

  # ── ORGANISM 4a — Preview Routes ──────────────────────────────────────
  - id: step-4a-preview-routes
    name: Build preview routes (derived from source legacy-static/preview/*)
    type: agent
    agent: design-chief
    command: "*build-preview-routes"
    inputs:
      legacy_previews: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/legacy-static/preview/*.html"
      primitives: "{{step-3-primitives.ui_primitives_baseline}}"
      composition: "{{step-3-primitives.composition_components}}"
    sub_actions:
      - "Generate src/app/preview/layout.tsx with sidebar + theme-toggle"
      - "Generate src/app/preview/page.tsx (index listing all preview cards)"
      - "FOR EACH legacy-static/preview/*.html → generate src/app/preview/{slug}/page.tsx preserving visual parity"
      - "If source has specialized categories (e.g., brand/colors/type/spacing/components), group them in layout nav"
    outputs:
      preview_routes: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/src/app/preview/"
    parallel_with: step-4b-kit-routes
    validation:
      - "Every legacy-static/preview/*.html has corresponding src/app/preview/{slug}/page.tsx"
      - "Preview layout has theme-toggle"
      - "Index page lists all routes"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail

  # ── ORGANISM 4b — Kit Routes ──────────────────────────────────────────
  - id: step-4b-kit-routes
    name: "Build kit routes (EMERGENT surfaces from brand-profile, NOT hardcoded)"
    type: agent
    agent: design-chief
    command: "*build-kit-routes"
    inputs:
      discovered_surfaces: "{{step-0-brand-discovery.discovered_surfaces}}"
      legacy_kits: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/legacy-static/ui_kits/"
      primitives: "{{step-3-primitives.ui_primitives_baseline}}"
      specialized: "{{step-3-primitives.ui_primitives_specialized}}"
      composition: "{{step-3-primitives.composition_components}}"
    sub_actions:
      - "Generate src/app/kits/page.tsx (index of discovered surfaces)"
      - "FOR EACH discovered surface (from brand-profile.surfaces):"
      - "  - mkdir src/app/kits/{surface-name}/"
      - "  - Generate layout.tsx (surface-specific shell per category — product=sidebar+main, marketing=topbar+footer, docs=sidebar+TOC, pitch-deck=slides)"
      - "  - For each file in legacy-static/ui_kits/{surface-name}/ → generate corresponding route"
      - "  - Use specialized primitives when surface requires them (composer for chat, hero for marketing, etc)"
      - "  - DO NOT hardcode surface names — they come from discovery"
    outputs:
      kit_routes: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/src/app/kits/"
      kit_composition: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/src/components/{discovered-surface-name}/"
    parallel_with: step-4a-preview-routes
    validation:
      - "src/app/kits/ has subdir per discovered surface"
      - "Each surface has coherent shell matching its category"
      - "No surface is hardcoded to anthropic/redpine/aiox names"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail

  # ── ORGANISM 5 — QA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - id: step-5-qa-gates
    name: "Run QA gates (archetype INVARIANT quality contract)"
    type: script
    inputs:
      profile: "{{profile}}"
    commands:
      - cmd: "npx tsc --noEmit"
        working_dir: "apps/{{target_app_name}}"
        must_pass: true
      - cmd: "npm run build"
        working_dir: "apps/{{target_app_name}}"
        must_pass: true
        note: "Framework-agnostic — resolves to 'next build' for framework=next or 'tsc --noEmit && vite build' for framework=vite"
      - cmd: "npx eslint src/ --max-warnings=0"
        working_dir: "apps/{{target_app_name}}"
        must_pass: false
        note: "ESLint 9 + FlatCompat + next/core-web-vitals emits schema-validation noise; exit 0 acceptable"
      - cmd: "grep -rn '<svg ' src/ | wc -l"
        working_dir: "apps/{{target_app_name}}"
        must_equal: "0 (or allowlisted brand SVGs)"
        note: "Registered-icon-library-only policy per archetype.invariant.quality_gates. The chosen library is brand-driven — see archetype.brand_driven.icons"
      - cmd: "grep -rn ':\\s*any\\b' src/ | wc -l"
        working_dir: "apps/{{target_app_name}}"
        must_equal: 0
    visual_gate:
      lean: "squads/design-ops/checklists/visual-gate-lean.yaml (manual)"
      full: "playwright (automated regression)"
    outputs:
      tsc_pass: boolean
      build_pass: boolean
      lint_pass: boolean
      visual_gate_verdict: "PASS | FAIL"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail

  # ── ORGANISM 6 — Polish ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  - id: step-6-fix-polish
    name: "Fix and polish (archetype INVARIANT dark-mode + registered icon library + cleanup)"
    type: agent
    agent: design-chief
    command: "*finalize"
    inputs:
      src: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/src/"
      visual_gate_checklist: "squads/design-ops/checklists/visual-gate-lean.yaml"
      guardrails: "squads/design-ops/checklists/dops-ai-trope-guardrails.yaml"
    sub_actions:
      - "Wire next-themes + ThemeProvider in layout.tsx (persistence + FOUC prevention)"
      - "Migrate inline <svg> to the registered icon library (per `archetype.brand_driven.icons`; default lucide-react; brand-specific SVGs allowlisted)"
      - "Strip dead legacy token aliases from globals.css"
      - "Audit inline styles — keep only data-driven swatches when no scale token covers it"
      - "Apply visual-gate-lean content-discipline checks (no filler, no data slop, ask-before-adding)"
      - "Apply visual-gate-lean scale-minimums checks (24px deck / 44px mobile / 12pt print / 44×44 hit area)"
      - "Apply dops-ai-trope-guardrails checks (placeholder-over-bad-attempt, source-code-first, no-aggressive-gradients, oklch-harmonic-extension)"
      - "Update README + SKILL.md with stack + archetype reference + brand-profile summary + missing-asset caveats"
    outputs:
      themes_persistent: boolean
      icons_consolidated: boolean
      dead_aliases_stripped: boolean
      docs_updated: boolean
      content_discipline_pass: boolean
      scale_minimums_pass: boolean
      guardrails_pass: boolean
    validation:
      - "Zero inline <svg> where the registered icon library covers it"
      - "Zero dead alias vars in globals.css"
      - "visual-gate-lean content-discipline section: PASS (0 CRITICAL)"
      - "visual-gate-lean scale-minimums section: PASS (0 CRITICAL)"
      - "dops-ai-trope-guardrails imagery section: PASS (placeholder policy applied where assets missing)"
      - "Final tsc + build re-run passa"
    error_handling:
      strategy: fail

quality_gates:
  G0:
    name: "Discovery gate"
    criteria:
      - "brand-profile.yaml emitido e YAML-valid"
      - "Pelo menos 1 accent color detectado"
      - "Pelo menos 1 typography tier (display OR body) detectado"
      - "baseline_coverage lista 24 primitives (cada com status matched|missing_from_source)"
      - "proposed_specialized tem evidence_score per entry"
      - "User approval coletado (interactive) ou auto-approved (yolo)"
  G1:
    name: "Scaffold gate"
    criteria:
      - "package.json exists"
      - "tsconfig strict true"
      - "components.json new-york + cssVariables true"
      - "npm install exit 0"
  G2:
    name: "Tokens gate"
    criteria:
      - "@theme inline block presente"
      - "Type scale, leading, tracking, colors todos wired"
      - ".dark variant declarado"
      - "Brand colors do brand-profile traduzidos corretamente"
  G3:
    name: "Primitives gate (parallelization unlock)"
    criteria:
      - "24 baseline primitives gerados"
      - "N specialized primitives gerados (N = approved at G0)"
      - "3+ composition components gerados"
      - "tsc --noEmit passes"
      - "Preview routes e Kit routes MAY agora rodar em paralelo"
  G4:
    name: "Route system join gate"
    criteria:
      - "Todos legacy previews têm Next routes"
      - "Todos discovered surfaces têm route namespaces"
      - "tsc --noEmit passes"
  G5:
    name: "QA gate"
    criteria:
      - "tsc pass"
      - "next build pass"
      - "Zero inline SVG non-allowlisted"
      - "Zero `any` types"
      - "Visual gate PASS (lean: manual checklist; full: playwright regression)"
  G6:
    name: "Polish gate"
    criteria:
      - "next-themes integrated with ThemeProvider wrapper"
      - "Zero inline <svg> where the registered icon library covers it"
      - "Zero legacy dead aliases"
      - "Zero non-data-driven inline styles"
      - "README and SKILL.md reflect new stack + archetype + brand-profile"
      # GAP-DS-010 (2026-04-19, Redpine): stack-discipline gates
      - "scripts/check-token-drift.mjs presente (scaffold dropped from template)"
      - "npm run check:drift exit 0 (5 anti-patterns absent)"
      - "scripts/build-manifest.mjs presente; components.manifest.json committed"
      - "src/design-system/exports/tokens.dtcg.json presente e DTCG-valid"
      - "package.json tem designTokensLanguageServer config"
      - "globals.css tem regra de foco WCAG 2.2 AAA global (3px+3px+transition:none+:is guards)"
      - "components.map.json: 100% dos componentes com `status` field"
      - "components.map.json: 100% dos componentes ready com `a11y` metadata completo"

  G7:
    name: "Continuous Drift Audit (post-delivery)"
    description: >-
      GAP-DS-010 — Post-migration loop of disciplina contínua. Runs in CI on
      schedule (weekly default). Closes the "scaffold well but no enforcement"
      fraqueza-sombra identified in Redpine session retrospective.
    schedule: "weekly"
    criteria:
      - "npm run check:drift exit 0 (no regression vs previous audit)"
      - "npm run build:manifest succeeds"
      - "npm run build:tokens succeeds (regenerates CSS + TS + DTCG)"
      - "components with status=ready maintain 100% a11y metadata coverage"
      - "Drift count vs last audit: ≤ 0 (no new violations introduced)"
      - "Status distribution report: count of ready/beta/experimental/deprecated logged"
    output: "outputs/design-ops/{{target_app_name}}/continuous-audit-{{date}}.yaml"
    on_failure:
      - "File issue against target app with drift report"
      - "Notify design-chief for triage"
      - "Non-blocking: does NOT revert migration; records regression trend"

QG-PRIOR-ART.1:
  name: "Prior-art compliance"
  applies_to: "Any CREATE verdict in infrastructure mapping"
  criteria:
    - "gap_analysis.md contém Prior-Art Search section"
    - "Cada CREATE tem grep/glob evidence documentada"
    - "Nenhum fictional artifact path"

outputs:
  migration_complete:
    type: boolean
    source: step-6-fix-polish.success
  app_location:
    type: string
    value: "apps/{{target_app_name}}/"
  brand_profile_emitted:
    type: string
    value: "outputs/design-ops/{{target_app_name}}/brand-profile.yaml"
  compliance_score:
    type: integer
    source: step-5-qa-gates.verdict
    threshold: 80

global_error_handling:
  on_error: halt_at_last_good_gate
  resumption: true
  notification:
    enabled: true
    channels: [console]

security:
  authorization_required: false
  audit_logging: true

downstream_gaps:
  - id: GAP-DS-001
    description: "scaffold-ds.sh wrapper script"
    status: closed_by_this_workflow
    path: squads/design-ops/scripts/design-system/scaffold-ds.sh
  - id: GAP-DS-003a
    description: "visual-gate-lean.yaml checklist"
    status: closed_by_this_workflow
    path: squads/design-ops/checklists/visual-gate-lean.yaml
  - id: GAP-DS-003b
    description: "Playwright visual regression tooling (full profile only)"
    status: open
    owner: "target project team"
    effort: "~3h per project"

metadata:
  author: "Design Ops Squad"
  created_date: "2026-04-19"
  version_history:
    - version: 1.0.0
      date: "2026-04-19"
      note: "Initial from SINKRA map — 6 organisms, hardcoded 24 primitives, 3 surface names"
    - version: 2.0.0
      date: "2026-04-19"
      note: "Added Organism 0 Brand Discovery; promoted archetype to data/ds-archetype.yaml; kit surfaces now derived (not hardcoded); specialized primitives require discovery evidence + approval"
  source_map: outputs/sinkra-squad/migracao-ds-estatico-para-dinamico-tokenizado/
  sinkra_compliance_score: 87
  reference_execution: apps/anthropic-ds
  tags:
    - design-system
    - migration
    - nextjs
    - tailwind-v4
    - shadcn
    - typescript
    - brownfield
    - archetype-driven
```
