```yaml
workflow:
  type: legacy
  name: Brandbook Workspace Extraction
  id: wf-brandbook-workspace-extraction
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Workflow para extrair conhecimento de brandbook implementado em código e materializar contratos canônicos no workspace (workspace-first).
  squad: design-ops
  orchestrator: design-chief
  command: "*extract-brandbook-workspace"
  estimated_duration: 30-90min
  sequence:
    - step: resolve-contracts
      id: resolve-contracts
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Resolver contratos canônicos
      agent: design-chief
      action: node squads/design-ops/scripts/resolve-workspace-contracts.cjs --business={business} --format=yaml
      next: extract-and-map
    - step: extract-and-map
      id: extract-and-map
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Extrair e mapear brandbook
      agent: design-chief
      action: execute_task_dops-extract-brandbook-to-workspace-contracts
      next: validate-contracts
    - step: validate-contracts
      id: validate-contracts
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Validar contratos
      agent: design-chief
      action: node squads/design-ops/scripts/validate-workspace-contracts.cjs --business={business} --strict --format=json
      next: run-checklists
    - step: run-checklists
      id: run-checklists
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Executar checklists de qualidade e acessibilidade
      agent: design-chief
      action: node squads/design-ops/scripts/validate-checklists-gate.cjs --business={business} --ds-root={ds_root}
      next: validate-yaml
    - step: validate-yaml
      id: validate-yaml
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Validar YAML alterado
      agent: design-chief
      action: npm run validate:yaml:changed
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete

inputs:
  required:
    - name: business
      description: "Business slug (ex.: aiox)"
    - name: ds_root
      description: Caminho raiz do brandbook implementado em código
  optional:
    - name: workspace_design_root
      description: Caminho de override para contratos no workspace

outputs:
  required:
    - workspace/businesses/{business}/L2-tactical/design/tokens.yaml
    - workspace/businesses/{business}/L2-tactical/design/foundations.yaml
    - workspace/businesses/{business}/L2-tactical/design/component-contracts.yaml
    - workspace/businesses/{business}/L2-tactical/design/motion-primitives.yaml
  validation_artifacts:
    - strict_contract_validation_json
    - yaml_incremental_validation_log

quality_gates:
  - id: gate-contracts-strict
    check: validate-workspace-contracts
    blocking: true
  - id: gate-a11y-and-quality
    check: checklists
    checklist_refs:
      - squads/design-ops/checklists/ds-core-accessibility-minimum.yaml
      - squads/design-ops/checklists/dops-accessibility-wcag-aa.yaml
      - squads/design-ops/checklists/dops-component-quality.yaml
```

## Referência: references/squad/workflows/wf-provider-enrichment-from-external.yaml

```yaml
workflow:
  id: dops-provider-enrichment-from-external
  name: Provider Enrichment — External Prompt Ingestion
  description: >-
    Meta-workflow que aplica os guardrails e o protocolo de criação absorvidos
    de prompts externos (ponto de partida: agenmod/claw-design, 2026-04-18).
    Costura intake estruturado → exploração divergente → AI-trope gate →
    responsive scaling gate → build do componente → verificação pós-build.
  version: 1.0.0
  type: sequential
  squad: design-ops
  orchestrator: design-chief
  command: "*dops-enrich-from-external {business} {surface}"
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-intake
      id: step-1-intake
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Brief intake estruturado (Questions-first)
      agent: design-chief
      action: >-
        materialize design-brief-intake from
        squads/design-ops/templates/design-brief-intake-tmpl.yaml
        for business={business} surface={surface}
      artifact_contract: design-brief-intake
      gate:
        type: elicitation
        required_fields:
          - brief.problem_statement
          - brief.success_criteria
          - audience.device_mix
          - contracts.tokens_source
      next: step-2-divergent-exploration

    - step: step-2-divergent-exploration
      id: step-2-divergent-exploration
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Exploração divergente (N ≥ 3 variantes)
      agent: design-chief
      action: >-
        produce_variants --axes match_existing,novel,constraint_first
        --brief design-brief-intake --min-variants 3
      gate:
        type: count_check
        min_variants: 3
        convergence_rule: "must reference brief.success_criteria"
      next: step-3-ai-trope-gate

    - step: step-3-ai-trope-gate
      id: step-3-ai-trope-gate
      phase: 3
      phase_name: AI-trope guardrails gate
      agent: design-chief
      action: >-
        node squads/design-ops/scripts/validate-checklists-gate.cjs
        --business={business}
        --checklist squads/design-ops/checklists/dops-ai-trope-guardrails.yaml
      blocking: true
      next: step-4-workspace-contracts

    - step: step-4-workspace-contracts
      id: step-4-workspace-contracts
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Validar contratos do workspace
      agent: design-chief
      action: >-
        node squads/design-ops/scripts/validate-workspace-contracts.cjs
        --business={business} --format=json --strict
      blocking: true
      next: step-5-build

    - step: step-5-build
      id: step-5-build
      phase: 5
      phase_name: Build do componente (com divergent exploration embutido)
      agent: design-chief
      action: "execute task squads/design-ops/tasks/ds-build-component.md"
      inputs_from_previous:
        - design-brief-intake
        - variants_scratch
      next: step-6-component-quality

    - step: step-6-component-quality
      id: step-6-component-quality
      phase: 6
      phase_name: Gate de qualidade (componentes + responsive + AI-trope)
      agent: design-chief
      action: >-
        node squads/design-ops/scripts/validate-checklists-gate.cjs
        --business={business}
        --checklist squads/design-ops/checklists/dops-component-quality.yaml
      blocking: true
      next: step-7-lint

    - step: step-7-lint
      id: step-7-lint
      phase: 7
      phase_name: Lint
      agent: design-chief
      action: npm run lint
      blocking: true
      next: step-8-typecheck

    - step: step-8-typecheck
      id: step-8-typecheck
      phase: 8
      phase_name: Typecheck
      agent: design-chief
      action: npm run typecheck
      blocking: true
      next: step-9-yaml

    - step: step-9-yaml
      id: step-9-yaml
      phase: 9
      phase_name: Validar YAML alterado
      agent: design-chief
      action: npm run validate:yaml:changed
      blocking: true

    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete

inputs:
  required:
    - name: business
      description: "Slug da business unit (ex.: aiox)"
    - name: surface
      description: "Nome da superfície-alvo (componente, página, deck)"

outputs:
  - id: design-brief-intake
    description: "Brief estruturado materializado do template"
    path: "outputs/design-ops/{business}/briefs/{surface}-intake.yaml"
  - id: variants_scratch
    description: "Artefato de exploração divergente com N ≥ 3 variantes"
    path: "outputs/design-ops/{business}/exploration/{surface}-variants.md"
  - id: component_artifact
    description: "Componente produzido pela task ds-build-component"
    path: "outputs/design-ops/{business}/components/{surface}/"

quality_gates:
  - id: DOPS-ENRICH-GATE-001
    check: elicitation
    phase: step-1-intake
    blocking: true
  - id: DOPS-ENRICH-GATE-002
    check: count_check
    phase: step-2-divergent-exploration
    blocking: true
  - id: DOPS-ENRICH-GATE-003
    check: checklists
    checklist_refs:
      - squads/design-ops/checklists/dops-ai-trope-guardrails.yaml
    phase: step-3-ai-trope-gate
    blocking: true
  - id: DOPS-ENRICH-GATE-004
    check: validate-workspace-contracts
    phase: step-4-workspace-contracts
    blocking: true
  - id: DOPS-ENRICH-GATE-005
    check: checklists
    checklist_refs:
      - squads/design-ops/checklists/dops-component-quality.yaml
    phase: step-6-component-quality
    blocking: true
  - id: DOPS-ENRICH-GATE-006
    check: lint
    phase: step-7-lint
    blocking: true
  - id: DOPS-ENRICH-GATE-007
    check: typecheck
    phase: step-8-typecheck
    blocking: true
  - id: DOPS-ENRICH-GATE-008
    check: "validate:yaml:changed"
    phase: step-9-yaml
    blocking: true

provenance:
  external_source: "agenmod/claw-design — claude-design-sys-prompt.txt"
  absorbed_at: "2026-04-18"
  absorbed_by: "design-chief"
  related_rule: "squads/design-ops/rules/ai-trope-guardrails.md"
```

```yaml
workflow:
  id: dops-style-dictionary-token-pipeline
  name: Style Dictionary Token Pipeline
  description: |
    Build and validate token artifacts from the workspace canonical contracts.

    Source-of-truth chain:
      1. workspace/businesses/{biz}/L2-tactical/design/tokens.yaml  (instance)
      2. squads/design-ops/templates/ds-tokens-defaults-tmpl.yaml   (defaults — used to bootstrap (1) when missing)
      3. squads/design-ops/templates/ds-tokens-schema-tmpl.yaml      (contract — shape validation)

    Generates outputs in workspace/businesses/{biz}/L2-tactical/design/build/:
      tokens.json (DTCG), tokens.css, globals.css (Tailwind v4), tokens.scss, tokens.ts
  version: 1.0.0
  type: sequential
  squad: design-ops
  orchestrator: design-chief
  command: "*dops-token-pipeline {business}"
  references:
    schema_contract: "squads/design-ops/templates/ds-tokens-schema-tmpl.yaml"
    defaults_template: "squads/design-ops/templates/ds-tokens-defaults-tmpl.yaml"
    justification_matrix: "squads/design-ops/data/tier-1-token-defaults-justification.yaml"
  sequence:
    - step: step-1-validate-contracts
      id: step-1-validate-contracts
      phase: 1
      phase_name: Validar contratos canônicos
      agent: design-chief
      action: node squads/design-ops/scripts/validate-workspace-contracts.cjs --business={business} --strict --format=json
      next: step-2-build-token-artifacts
    - step: step-2-build-token-artifacts
      id: step-2-build-token-artifacts
      phase: 2
      phase_name: Gerar artefatos de tokens
      agent: design-chief
      action: node squads/design-ops/scripts/build-token-pipeline.cjs --business={business}
      next: step-3-validate-token-artifacts
    - step: step-3-validate-token-artifacts
      id: step-3-validate-token-artifacts
      phase: 3
      phase_name: Validar artefatos gerados
      agent: design-chief
      action: node squads/design-ops/scripts/validate-token-pipeline.cjs --business={business}
      next: step-4-yaml
    - step: step-4-yaml
      id: step-4-yaml
      phase: 4
      phase_name: Validar YAML alterado
      agent: design-chief
      action: npm run validate:yaml:changed
    - workflow_end:
        id: complete
        action: workflow_complete

inputs:
  required:
    - name: business
      description: "Slug da business unit (ex.: aiox)"

outputs:
  - outputs/design-ops/token-pipeline/{business}/tokens.json
  - outputs/design-ops/token-pipeline/{business}/tokens.css
  - outputs/design-ops/token-pipeline/{business}/manifest.json

quality_gates:
  - id: DOPS-GATE-001
    check: validate-workspace-contracts
    blocking: true
  - id: DOPS-GATE-008
    check: validate-token-pipeline
    blocking: true
  - id: DOPS-GATE-002
    check: "validate:yaml:changed"
    blocking: true
```
